en: subsequent propositions can clearly refer back to the assumption without mixing \(\mathbb R^3\), channels with periodic domains.

zh: 环带排除 → 源—核账本 → 协方差谱分层 → 全频条件桥 → response-slope 弦增益 → common-response 阶一通道 → 恒定投影符号 no-go → common-response packing no-go → 带符号正输出系数
en: Annular exclusion → source–kernel ledger → covariance spectral stratification → full-frequency conditional bridge → response-slope chord gain → order-one common-response channel → constant-projection sign no-go → common-response packing no-go → signed positive-output coefficient

zh: 回到有符号 Biot–Savart 核的物理空间环带分解，完整保留截断交换子和边界通量，并用仿射核心与六模态场做双重压力测试。
en: Return to a physical-space annular decomposition of the signed Biot-Savart kernel, retain every cutoff commutator and boundary flux, and stress-test it against both the affine core and the six-mode field.

zh: 活跃列的唯一正根已被隔离到宽度 \(10^{-18}\) 的有理区间；整个相邻百万分位窗口内，243 个竞争对象均严格更小。
en: The unique positive root of the active column has been isolated in a width-\(10^{-18}\) rational interval; throughout the adjacent-millionth window, all 243 competitors remain strictly smaller.

zh: 活跃约束和零荷约束对 \((A,B)\) 都是仿射函数。 精确矩符号把可行性化为三个必要不等式 \(H\le0\)、\(P\le0\)、\(Q\le0\)。在 \(r=0.382629\)、\(0.1337\le c\le0.803\) 上， 自适应张量 Bernstein 覆盖只需 14 个闭矩形：9 个由 \(H>0\) 排除，1 个由 \(P>0\) 排除，4 个由 \(Q>0\) 排除。两个根矩形的精确叶质量都等于一。
en: The active and zero-charge constraints are both affine functions of \((A,B)\). Exact moment signs reduce feasibility to three necessary inequalities \(H\le0\), \(P\le0\), and \(Q\le0\). On \(r=0.382629\), \(0.1337\le c\le0.803\), the adaptive tensor Bernstein cover needs only 14 closed rectangles: 9 excluded by \(H>0\), 1 by \(P>0\), and 4 by \(Q>0\). The exact leaf mass on each root rectangle equals one.

zh: 机器证书在现有 50/49 项系数窗口内枚举 216 个相关尾部主子式，其中 67 个为负。 这证明表中次数范围内的全称排除；“更晚没有负见证”仍只是一项有限窗口事实，不能反过来证明更高次背景存在。
en: The machine certificate enumerates 216 relevant tail principal minors within the available 50/49-coefficient window, of which 67 are negative. This proves the universal exclusions over the degree ranges in the table; no later negative witness remains only a finite-window fact and cannot be reversed into proof that a higher-degree background exists.

zh: 极化二阶鞍点与有限有理改进
en: polarized second-order saddle point and finite rational improvement

zh: 极化通道分解把唯一的二次项定位为 \(N^2|\sigma_A\sigma_B|\)；\(N=4,5\) 的高精度探针仍与 \(|\sigma|=O(N^{-1})\) 假设相容。
en: The polarization-channel decomposition identifies \(N^2|\sigma_A\sigma_B|\) as the only quadratic term; the high-precision probes at \(N=4,5\) remain consistent with the hypothesis \(|\sigma|=O(N^{-1})\).

zh: 几何基线
en: Geometric baseline

zh: 计算机辅助弱非唯一性预印本
en: computer-assisted weak non-uniqueness preprint

zh: 记 \(\delta_r=\|U_r(0)\|_{BMO^{-1}_{\rm per}}\) 与 \(\chi_r=4C_BM_T^2C_H\delta_r\)。当 \(\chi_r<1\) 时， 较小二次根同时封闭自映射与严格压缩，得到唯一的邻近解分支 \[ \|u_r-v\|_{X_T} \le \frac{1-\sqrt{1-\chi_r}}{2C_BM_T} \le2M_TC_H(6+4\sqrt2)\rho^r. \] 完整扰动自相互作用没有被删去，非线性只改变有界前因子， 不改变 \(\rho^r\) 的几何指数。18 项源锁定检查全部通过。
en: Let \(\delta_r=\|U_r(0)\|_{BMO^{-1}_{\rm per}}\) and \(\chi_r=4C_BM_T^2C_H\delta_r\). When \(\chi_r<1\), the smaller quadratic root closes both the self-map and strict-contraction estimates, producing the unique nearby solution branch \[ \|u_r-v\|_{X_T} \le \frac{1-\sqrt{1-\chi_r}}{2C_BM_T} \le2M_TC_H(6+4\sqrt2)\rho^r. \] The full perturbation self-interaction is retained: nonlinearity changes only a bounded prefactor, not the geometric exponent \(\rho^r\). All 18 source-locked checks pass.

zh: 记录方式
en: records method

zh: 继承的主动尾界为 \(0.9944093112<1\)，完整残差约为 \(1.7968\times10^{-42}\)，球映射与 Lipschitz 条件严格通过。 相邻探针 \(257/1000\) 的多项式输运仍为 \(0.8672866880<1\)，但主动尾充分界变为 \(1.0002561524>1\)；瓶颈已经重新落在主动尾估计。
en: The inherited active-tail bound is \(0.9944093112<1\), the complete residual is about \(1.7968\times10^{-42}\), and the ball-mapping and Lipschitz conditions pass strictly. At the adjacent probe \(257/1000\), polynomial transport remains \(0.8672866880<1\), but the sufficient active-tail bound becomes \(1.0002561524>1\); the bottleneck has moved back to the active-tail estimate.

zh: 继续优化 \(\tau,\lambda\) 或无符号时间分片没有研究收益。 信息损失发生在把方向、符号与空间几何压成 \(\sup_I\|v\|_\infty\) 这一步。
en: Further optimization of \(\tau,\lambda\) or unsigned time partitions has no research payoff. The information is lost when direction, sign, and spatial geometry are compressed into \(\sup_I\|v\|_\infty\).

zh: 加权 Wiener 重启与解析半径扩张
en: Weighted Wiener restart and analytic-radius expansion

zh: 剪切结构可算，但解族始终光滑
en: The shear structure is computable, but the solution family remains smooth

zh: 检查
en: checking

zh: 检查带符号正输出系数能否沿真实 Navier–Stokes 演化获得时间可积控制，并排除循环使用既有 BMO/Besov 条件。
en: Test whether the signed positive-output coefficient admits time-integrable control along genuine Navier–Stokes evolution, while excluding any circular use of existing BMO/Besov conditions.

zh: 检查方法
en: checking method

zh: 检查是否存在临界耗散小因子
en: check for the existence of critical dissipative small parameter

zh: 检验符号先于平方的局部 tent 量是否沿真实方程获得非循环的时间可积控制；若它退化为普通正平方 Carleson/BMO 质量，就按停止规则关闭。
en: Test whether the local tent quantity with sign retained before squaring admits noncircular time-integrable control along the genuine equation; if it degenerates into the ordinary positive-square Carleson/BMO mass, close the branch under the stopping rule.

zh: 检验负阶 Sobolev 与 Hardy–BMO 近场对偶，要求在适当弱解能量空间中有意义、保留 \(2^{-5m}\) 远场增益，并避开已有正则性混合范数。
en: Test negative Sobolev and Hardy–BMO near-field duality, requiring it to be meaningful in the suitable-weak-solution energy space, retain the \(2^{-5m}\) far-field gain, and avoid mixed norms already covered by regularity theory.

zh: 检验局部能量不等式、反向热核截断与时间频率分解，能否把时间积分后的 \(\mu_v\sigma_v^3\) 降到二次 CKN 量加可吸收耗散。
en: Test whether the local energy inequality, a backward-heat-kernel cutoff, and a time-frequency decomposition can reduce the time-integrated \(\mu_v\sigma_v^3\) to quadratic CKN quantities plus absorbable dissipation.

zh: 简单有理乘积仿射权严格越过 R0.52 的完整单仿射上界。零荷列有唯一正阈值根，固定点重启通过，281 个竞争记录全部保留严格间隙；阈值半径的严格下增益超过 \(10.7949\) ppm。
en: A simple rational product-affine weight strictly exceeds the complete R0.52 single-affine upper bound. The zero-charge column has a unique positive root, the fixed-point restart passes, all 281 competitor records retain strict gaps, and the strict lower gain in threshold radius exceeds \(10.7949\) ppm.

zh: 见证目前是标量压力源，并非由无散速度生成。结果只关闭朴素调和 Taylor 减法，不排除速度生成约束或跨壳相消。
en: The current witness is a scalar pressure source, not one generated by a divergence-free velocity. The result closes only naive harmonic Taylor subtraction and does not exclude velocity-generated constraints or cross-shell cancellation.

zh: 建立近场、过渡环带与应力局部化远场尾的三区域压力预算，统一缩放后优化分离比。
en: Build a three-zone pressure budget for the near field, transition annulus, and stress-localized far tail, then optimize the separation ratio after a common scaling normalization.

zh: 建立现代弱解框架，并明确留下规则性与可能奇异性问题。
en: Establish a modern framework for weak solutions and explicitly leave the issues of regularity and possible singularities.

zh: 渐近极限使用六个自由载频坐标。八次中心矩每态有 \({14\choose6}=3003\) 个通道，总计 5,381,376 个矩坐标。 64 个带符号子集传输矩阵完成全部 1792 态仿射提升； 完整 35 次序的 binary64 主热配对稳定在 \[ B_{8,\mathrm{pilot}} =-1.4923824320396173\times10^{-8}. \] 七次到八次的修正约 \(4.27\times10^{-17}\)，但这个负号 仍是数值侦察，不是严格渐近定理。
en: The asymptotic limit uses six free carrier coordinates. Centered moments through degree eight have \({14\choose6}=3003\) channels per state, for a total of 5,381,376 moment coordinates. Sixty-four signed subset-transfer matrices complete the affine lift for all 1,792 states; the binary64 dominant heat pairing over all 35 orderings stabilizes at \[ B_{8,\mathrm{pilot}} =-1.4923824320396173\times10^{-8}. \] The correction from degree seven to degree eight is about \(4.27\times10^{-17}\), but this negative sign remains a numerical pilot rather than a rigorous asymptotic theorem.

zh: 将适当弱解可能的奇异集合压缩到极小，但未能证明其为空。
en: Collapse the set of possible singularities for appropriate weak solutions to be minimal, but failed to prove its emptiness.

zh: 将载频偏移写成 \(rL+n\) 后，关系 \(A+B-C=Q\) 只允许 \(k=-1,0,1\) 三个进位。未加权相关因此精确分解为 \[ \sum_{Q\in J_m}\sum_{A+B-C=Q}c_Qc_Ac_Bc_C =\sum_{k=-1}^{1}I_{L,k}O_{M,m-1,k}. \] 合流热核依赖完整载频和时间顺序，所以真正的加权和不能直接张量分离。
en: Writing carrier offsets as \(rL+n\), the relation \(A+B-C=Q\) permits only the three carries \(k=-1,0,1\). The unweighted correlation therefore separates exactly as \[ \sum_{Q\in J_m}\sum_{A+B-C=Q}c_Qc_Ac_Bc_C =\sum_{k=-1}^{1}I_{L,k}O_{M,m-1,k}. \] The confluent heat kernel depends on the full carriers and time order, so the weighted sum does not separate directly.

zh: 交付
en: Deliver

zh: 较大的完整系数不等于封闭级联。 在 \(\varepsilon=0.2\) 的第五阶系数中，下一壳目标只占约 1.99% 的 \(\dot H^{1/2}\) 能量；Taylor 余项、稠密包极限和逐壳重复都没有控制。
en: larger complete coefficients are not equal to closed cascades. In the fifth-order coefficient of \(\varepsilon=0.2\), the next shell target only accounts for about 1.99% of the energy in \(\dot H^{1/2}\); Taylor remainder, dense packet limit, and shell-by-shell repetition did not control it.

zh: 阶段判断：
en: Stage assessment:

zh: 接下来的工作计划
en: Future work plan

zh: 结构化大数据与临界元
en: Structured large data and critical modes

zh: 结论边界：
en: Claim boundary:

zh: 解析半径二阶损失的尖锐障碍
en: Sharp obstruction for the second-order loss of analytic radius

zh: 解析极小只覆盖对称子族；完整十二参数下界和随 \(N\)、截断统一的 PDE 误差仍未建立。
en: The analytic minimum only covers symmetric subfamilies; a complete lower bound for twelve parameters under \(N\) and unified truncation of PDE errors have not yet been established.

zh: 解析域内的一步短延拓证书
en: A certified short continuation step inside the analytic domain

zh: 解析约化
en: Analytic reduction

zh: 紧支撑构造实现函数空间几何与初始面附近的严格正相关，但不提供一个共同固定正时间的有限能量级联。严格环带定位、真实压力轨道与 Leray 端点仍然开放；本结果不是正则性或奇性定理。
en: The compactly supported construction realizes the function-space geometry and strict positive correlation near the initial face, but it does not provide a finite-energy cascade at one common fixed positive time. Strict annular localization, genuine pressure trajectories, and the Leray endpoint remain open; this result is neither a regularity theorem nor a singularity theorem.

zh: 紧致模对称性、局部能量集中下界、backward uniqueness 所需的定量假设。
en: Quantitative assumptions required for compactness, symmetry, local energy concentration lower bounds, and backward uniqueness.

zh: 紧致性本身不会产生矛盾，关键仍是后面的 rigidity 步骤。
en: tightness itself does not produce contradictions, the key is still the subsequent rigidity step.

zh: 近场结论相反：\(N_r=r^{5/2}\|q_0\|_2\) 要求能量层级没有的 \(q_0\in L^2\)。一个光滑散度为零的高频族可使速度 \(L^3\) 与动能 Morrey 量趋零，同时 \(N_r\sim N\)、绝对环带 \(\int|u q|\sim N^{1/2}\) 发散。14 项形式检查全部通过。
en: The near-field conclusion is the opposite: \(N_r=r^{5/2}\|q_0\|_2\) requires \(q_0\in L^2\), unavailable at the energy level. A smooth divergence-free high-frequency family makes velocity \(L^3\) and the kinetic Morrey quantity tend to zero while \(N_r\sim N\) and the absolute annular quantity \(\int|u q|\sim N^{1/2}\) diverge. All 14 formal checks passed.

zh: 近对角螺旋核的精确极值
en: precise near-diagonal helical kernel extremum

zh: 近二维、缓慢变化、特定对称或稳定背景附近，可以构造范数任意大的全局光滑数据。 这证明“大”本身不是唯一障碍；危险在于尺度、方向和相互作用结构。
en: in nearly two-dimensional, slowly varying, specific symmetric or stable background regions, one can construct norms arbitrarily large global smooth data. This proves that "large" itself is not the only obstruction; the danger lies in scale, direction, and interaction structure.

zh: 精确 resultant、Sturm 计数与有理单变量表示关闭了四个有限面和四条边。 最大边界目标比例为 \(3.280940959752690\ldots\%\)，严格低于内部值 \(5.9518698677219236\ldots\%\)。因此第一个根是所选第五阶有限模型的唯一全局最大点。
en: precise resultant, Sturm count with rational univariate representation closes four finite faces and four edges. The maximum boundary target ratio is \(3.280940959752690\ldots\%\), strictly below internal values \(5.9518698677219236\ldots\%\). Therefore, the first root is the only global maximum point of the selected fifth-order finite model.

zh: 精确二元矩和有理单形余项认证了周期目标在 \(r=14\) 变号；随后十个四层块的绝对增长均严格超过 \(16\)。
en: Exact bivariate moments and the rational simplex remainder certify that the periodic target changes sign at \(r=14\); the absolute growth of each of the following ten four-level blocks is strictly above \(16\).

zh: 精确荷—次数格点、奇偶有理分支与 0.376932 重启
en: Exact charge–degree lattice, parity rational branches, and the restart at 0.376932

zh: 精确荷—次数格点把大正荷界压回一以下，共同半径推进到 0.376932；相邻百万分位 0.376933 在真实 \(s=162,j=81\) 列上超过一。
en: The exact charge–degree lattice lowers the large-positive-charge bound below one and advances the common radius to 0.376932; at the adjacent millionth 0.376933, the true \(s=162,j=81\) column exceeds one.

zh: 精确荷核闭合了 242 个有限扇区与全部无穷大荷扇区，共同解析半径提高到 \(397/2000\)；新的瓶颈已经转移到输运算子。
en: The exact charge kernel closes 242 finite sectors and the entire infinite large-charge sector, raising the common analytic radius to \(397/2000\); the new bottleneck has moved to the transport operator.

zh: 精确两端点输运与共同解析半径扩张
en: Exact two-endpoint transport and enlargement of the common radius of analyticity

zh: 精确三变量商在半径 \(10^{-30}\) 的有理盒内有唯一驻点；其反对称 Hessian 由区间对角占优证明正定。
en: precise three-variable quotient has a unique stationary point in the rational box with radius \(10^{-30}\); its antisymmetric Hessian is proven positive definite by interval diagonal dominance.

zh: 精确无外力周期剪切在全部标量或逐分量滤波尺度上保持秩一；单轴 helical 波保持一个共同法向量。双轴 helical 正对照说明正定性来自新增方向，不来自观测数量。即使排除精确二维并要求真正三维、有限能量和满秩，整空间 Schwartz 族仍给出 \[ Q_L=\pi^{3/2}\operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac1{4L},\frac1{4L},2L\right), \qquad c_*=\frac1{8L^2+2}\longrightarrow0. \]
en: Exact unforced periodic shear remains rank one under scalar or componentwise filtering at every scale; a single-axis helical wave retains a common normal direction. The two-axis helical positive control shows that positive definiteness comes from adding a direction, not from increasing the number of observations. Even after excluding exactly two-dimensional flows and requiring genuine three-dimensionality, finite energy, and full rank, a whole-space Schwartz family still gives \[ Q_L=\pi^{3/2}\operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac1{4L},\frac1{4L},2L\right), \qquad c_*=\frac1{8L^2+2}\longrightarrow0. \]

zh: 精确系数公式覆盖全部 dyadic \(L,M\) 与目标 \(m\)，但正性、观测最大值和未见 \(M\) 增长都只是有限计算证据。 当前没有全指标一致界，也没有完整高阶余项控制；该频率包仍属于 全局光滑剪切类。
en: The exact coefficient formula covers every dyadic \(L,M\) and target \(m\), but positivity, the observed maximum, and the absence of observed growth in \(M\) are finite computational evidence only. There is currently no all-index uniform bound or control of the full higher-order remainder; the packet remains in a globally smooth shear class.

zh: 精确相邻壳三波边可以构造，但归一化第一 Picard 临界能量按 \(4^{-5j}\) 衰减。
en: precise adjacent shell triad edges can be constructed, but the normalized first Picard critical energy decays according to \(4^{-5j}\).

zh: 精确应力交换子到达空间能量层级，但时间积分仍是三次的
en: The exact stress commutator reaches the spatial energy level, but the time integral remains cubic

zh: 精确有理计算在 \(s=44,45,47,46\) 找到四个负尾部 Gram 行列式， 因而统一排除 \(B_U,B_V,H_U,H_V\) 的全部 43、44、46、45 次及以下实多项式背景。 四个见证都用独立的 Fraction Leibniz 行列式复算。
en: Exact rational computation finds four negative tail Gram determinants at \(s=44,45,47,46\), thereby uniformly excluding every real polynomial background through degrees 43, 44, 46, and 45 for \(B_U,B_V,H_U,H_V\). All four witnesses are independently recomputed with a Fraction Leibniz determinant.

zh: 精确锥链与稀疏 Duhamel 障碍
en: precise cone chain with sparse Duhamel obstruction

zh: 精细点的一阶残差虽小但严格非零， 所以尚未得到局部极小或全局最优定理；热项、Taylor 余项和完整 PDE 仍未包含。
en: the first-order residual at fine points is small but strictly non-zero, so local minima or global optimality theorems have not yet been obtained; heat terms, Taylor remainder, and complete PDE are still missing.

zh: 静态环带族被严格排除后，主线转向协方差秩分层与全频投影桥。R0.71A 证明恒定主投影仍不能决定协方差功符号；R0.71B 又用两个任意壳数族排除无权 \(\ell^2\to\ell^1\) packing 和一个直接三场极化端点，并留下能进入 enstrophy 不等式的带符号正输出系数。
en: After the static annular family was rigorously excluded, the main line turned to covariance-rank stratification and a full-frequency projection bridge. R0.71A showed that even a constant principal projection cannot determine the sign of the covariance work; R0.71B then used two families with arbitrarily many shells to rule out unweighted \(\ell^2\to\ell^1\) packing and a direct polarized three-field endpoint, while leaving a signed positive-output coefficient that can enter the enstrophy inequality.

zh: 九阶目标投影由严格频率缺口 \(H-4D=4\) 消失，所以保留八阶 后的第一个尾项从九次相互作用开始。与精确正二阶系数比较， 在 \(M_r=16^r\)、 \(\varepsilon_r^2=(16/\lambda)^r\) 上得到 \[ \frac{|\mathcal R_{\ge10,r}|} {|A_r^2\widehat G_2(0,m_r,t_{H_r})|} <\frac1{30000}\left(\frac{43}{64}\right)^r. \]
en: The ninth-order target projection vanishes by the strict frequency gap \(H-4D=4\), so after order eight the first tail term begins with nine interactions. Comparing with the exact positive quadratic coefficient gives, for \(M_r=16^r\) and \(\varepsilon_r^2=(16/\lambda)^r\), \[ \frac{|\mathcal R_{\ge10,r}|} {|A_r^2\widehat G_2(0,m_r,t_{H_r})|} <\frac1{30000}\left(\frac{43}{64}\right)^r. \]

zh: 两个输入都位于 \([L,2L)\) 壳；尺度比不超过 \(1/L\)，第二个角帽 的孔径不超过 \(\arctan(1/L)\)。两者同时趋于零时，尖锐比值仍为一。 对两个输入同时施加热半群后，输出和两块范数乘积都等于 \[ e^{-\nu t}\sum_Nc_N^2e^{-2\nu N^2t}, \] 因而瞬时比值对每个 \(t\ge0\) 仍为一。
en: Both inputs lie in the \([L,2L)\) shell. The scale ratio is at most \(1/L\), and the aperture of the second angular cap is at most \(\arctan(1/L)\). As both tend to zero, the sharp ratio remains one. After applying the heat semigroup to both inputs, the output and the product of the two block norms are both \[ e^{-\nu t}\sum_Nc_N^2e^{-2\nu N^2t}, \] so the instantaneous ratio remains one for every \(t\ge0\).

zh: 两个有限点支持抑制趋势，但不能证明所有 \(N\) 的有界或次二次增长。 当前应先分析二维边界递推的纵向主导项与组合权重，再决定是否计算 \(N=4\)。
en: Two finite points support a suppression trend, but cannot prove bounded or subquadratic growth for every \(N\). The next task is to analyze the longitudinal leading terms and combinatorial weights in the two-dimensional boundary recurrence before deciding whether to compute \(N=4\).

zh: 两壳 HHL 族的 common-response 符号满足 \[ \mathcal U_M\longrightarrow1, \qquad M^2\mathcal C_M\longrightarrow-\frac12, \] 因而 response chord 的二次衰减不能传给共同通道。把同一个低模连接到 \(N\) 个严格分离高壳后，总共同功趋于 \(1/4\)，逐壳功的 \(\ell^2\) 范数却只有 \(O(N^{-1/2})\)。另一个等半径共享高模族则使三场极化算子比按 \(\sqrt N\) 增长。
en: For the two-shell HHL family, the common-response symbols satisfy \[ \mathcal U_M\longrightarrow1, \qquad M^2\mathcal C_M\longrightarrow-\frac12, \] so the quadratic decay of the response chord cannot be transferred to the common channel. After the same low mode is connected to \(N\) strictly separated high shells, the total common work tends to \(1/4\), whereas the \(\ell^2\) norm of the shellwise works is only \(O(N^{-1/2})\). A second family, with a shared high mode of equal radius, makes the polarized three-field operator ratio grow like \(\sqrt N\).

zh: 两种可能的结果

zh: 两组精确周期初值具有相同的 \((\Sigma,B,q)\)、动能和全部非压力账本；只有压力收缩不同，最终得到 \[ \dot q_-={3901\over2040}>0, \qquad \dot q_+=-{1283\over2040}<0. \] 这关闭了只依赖当前局部源与局部形状的非平凡普适 Lyapunov 路线，但没有排除非局部压力、空间积分、历史或相邻尺度状态。

Direction-covariant vector charges, directional sectors, suprema over multiple frames, and shell--angle--polarization states remain open. This gives no a priori bound for arbitrary large data and is not a three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity result.

The route that first takes a common norm of the complete state at every level is therefore excluded.

zh: 令 \(Q=\int\chi\,\Omega\otimes\Omega\)、\(E=\operatorname{tr}Q>0\)，真正无量纲的各向异性是 \[ B=\frac{Q}{E}-\frac13I. \] 若 \(F=\dot Q\)，则 \(\dot B=(\operatorname{dev}F-B\operatorname{tr}F)/E\)：纯振幅变化被精确消去，并有 \(0\le|B|_F^2\le2/3\)，但这个界不提供小各向异性，也没有控制原始因子 \(E\)。
en: Let \(Q=\int\chi\,\Omega\otimes\Omega\) and \(E=\operatorname{tr}Q>0\). The genuinely dimensionless anisotropy is \[ B=\frac{Q}{E}-\frac13I. \] If \(F=\dot Q\), then \(\dot B=(\operatorname{dev}F-B\operatorname{tr}F)/E\): pure amplitude changes cancel exactly, and \(0\le|B|_F^2\le2/3\), but this bound neither makes the anisotropy small nor controls the original factor \(E\).

zh: 另外，若实标量荷 \(\chi\) 同时满足卷积可加性与完整 \(SO(3)\) 不变性，则半转把 \(\xi\) 送到 \(-\xi\)， 迫使 \(\chi(-\xi)=\chi(\xi)=-\chi(\xi)\)，所以 \(\chi\equiv0\)。这个证明不需要连续性。
en: In addition, if a real scalar charge \(\chi\) is both convolution-additive and fully \(SO(3)\)-invariant, a half-turn maps \(\xi\) to \(-\xi\), forcing \(\chi(-\xi)=\chi(\xi)=-\chi(\xi)\), hence \(\chi\equiv0\). This proof requires no continuity.

zh: 六变量总阶十一的 4,368 个多重指标已经全部扫描并进入 GMP 有理审计。120 项时间区间的宽度为 \(4.8185\times10^{-118}\)，严格得到 \[ \max_{|\alpha|=11}|\partial^\alpha H| <2.567\times10^{-6}. \] 最大指标是 \((0,0,0,11,0,0)\)；这一结论来自全扫描， 不是预先假定纯偏导控制全部混合导数。
en: All 4,368 six-variable multi-indices of total degree eleven have been scanned and entered into the GMP rational audit. A 120-term time interval of width \(4.8185\times10^{-118}\) rigorously gives \[ \max_{|\alpha|=11}|\partial^\alpha H| <2.567\times10^{-6}. \] The maximizing index is \((0,0,0,11,0,0)\). This conclusion comes from the complete scan, not from assuming in advance that pure derivatives control all mixed derivatives.

zh: 六次与八次项的每四位块收缩率分别小于 0.636143 和 0.404678；全部十次以上项统一受 \((43/64)^r/30000\) 控制；三、五、七、九次项精确为零。 因而这个命题没有留下未计算的 Picard 阶，非零四次谱分支 在完整非线性求和后仍然存在。
en: The per-four-bit-block contraction rates of the sixth- and eighth-order terms are below 0.636143 and 0.404678, respectively; all orders at least ten are uniformly bounded by \((43/64)^r/30000\); and orders three, five, seven, and nine vanish exactly. Thus no uncomputed Picard order remains in the statement, and the nonzero quartic spectral branch survives the complete nonlinear sum.

zh: 六阶返回路径精确闭合为 320 态五载频传输；零时间可达标量具有严格负的主谱投影，主根 \(\mu=16\lambda>400\)。
en: The sixth-order return paths close exactly as a 320-state five-carrier transfer. The reachable zero-time scalar has a strictly negative dominant spectral projection, with dominant root \(\mu=16\lambda>400\).

zh: 六阶中心 jet 与全局七阶导数界把渐近主热投影压入严格负区间；第一周期正号与渐近负号共同给出有限尺度换号。
en: A sixth-order centred jet and a global seventh-derivative bound confine the asymptotic dominant heat projection to a strictly negative interval; the positive first cycle and negative asymptotic sign together force a finite-scale sign change.

zh: 六维 Riemann 和极限表明， \[ \frac{|\mathfrak T(u_N)|} {\|u_N\|_{\dot H^{1/2}}\|u_N\|_{\dot H^{3/2}}^2} \] 收敛到正常数。因此，高频和近对角支撑本身不能给出趋于零的统一改进因子。
en: six-dimensional Riemann sum limit shows that \[ \frac{|\mathfrak T(u_N)|} {\|u_N\|_{\dot H^{1/2}}\|u_N\|_{\dot H^{3/2}}^2} \] converges to a normal number. Therefore, high-frequency and near-diagonal support alone cannot provide a unifying factor tending to zero.

en: helical decomposition gives two cases: low-mode energy transfer of same-sign high-frequency helices is inhibited by \(K/P\), while opposite-sign high-frequency helices do not have this factor. Therefore, it cannot be assumed that all nonlocal triads will approximately cancel out.

en: Every binary input monomial also satisfies \(s\le2j\). Therefore \[ j\ge\max\left\{N+1,\left\lceil\frac S2\right\rceil\right\}, \] for \(N=80,S=241\), this gives the uniform floor \(j\ge121\). Only the old prefactor \((i+81)/(i+80)\) is replaced by \((i+121)/(i+120)\); the remaining termwise large-charge bounds and the common-endpoint theorem for finite charges are unchanged.

zh: 每个候选估计都要经过 NS 缩放、单三波测试和多壳级联测试。

zh: 每个加权列都是半径的非负系数多项式。我用右端竞争上界与左端 活跃值做单调夹逼，覆盖 238 个其他固定正荷、\(s=162\) 的一个 非活跃端点和另外四个穷尽扇区。最接近者为 \(s=164\)，仍留下 \(9.9933786489\times10^{-5}\) 的严格间隙。
en: Every weighted column is a polynomial in the radius with nonnegative coefficients. I use a monotone sandwich between right-end competitor upper bounds and the left-end active value, covering 238 other fixed positive charges, one inactive endpoint for \(s=162\), and the four remaining exhaustive sectors. The closest is \(s=164\), with a strict gap of \(9.9933786489\times10^{-5}\).

zh: 每个频率壳满足形式上的局部能量关系

The complete active-tail bound at the target radius is \(0.9972280412<1\), and the ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and canonical-stretch gates all pass. At the adjacent \(r=0.372\), the same exact \(j=82,s=-1\) column is \(1.0010616516>1\), while the large-charge sector remains \(0.9766138680<1\).

zh: 目标符号两态、三次乘积八态和三个系数进位合并为精确的 \(48\times48\) 整数递推。按最低位到最高位读取 \(0100\)， 四步乘积的秩为 \(6\)，完整特征多项式含有一个位于 \((25,26)\) 的实根。
en: Two target-sign states, eight cubic-product states, and three coefficient carries combine into an exact \(48\times48\) integer recursion. Reading \(0100\) from the least significant bit upward, the four-step product has rank \(6\), and its full characteristic polynomial has a real root in \((25,26)\).

zh: 频率族 \(p_N=(N,0,0)\)、\(q_N=(-N,1,0)\)、 \(k=(0,1,0)\)，配合 \(a=e_2\)、\(b=e_3\)，满足 \(P_k[(q_N\cdot a)b]=b\)。对每个正整数 \(N\)，归一化 临界符号比精确等于一，而输入/输出尺度分离等于 \(N\)。 因此尺度分离本身不能提供统一的小因子。
en: The frequency family \(p_N=(N,0,0)\), \(q_N=(-N,1,0)\), and \(k=(0,1,0)\), together with \(a=e_2\) and \(b=e_3\), satisfies \(P_k[(q_N\cdot a)b]=b\). For every positive integer \(N\), the normalized critical symbol ratio equals one exactly, while the input/output scale separation equals \(N\). Thus scale separation alone cannot supply a uniform small factor.

zh: 平方根上界是全指标定理；扫描正性和小数 最大值只是有限证据。上界仍随 \(M\) 增长，完整偶数阶余项也没有 控制；该频率包仍属于全局光滑剪切类。
en: The square-root bound is an all-index theorem; scan positivity and the decimal maximum are finite evidence. The bound still grows with \(M\), the complete even-order remainder remains uncontrolled, and the packet belongs to a globally smooth shear class.

zh: 平移、缩放与频率漂移使极限过程丢失紧致性；潜在奇点可以沿嵌套尺度逃逸。
en: translation, scaling, and frequency drift cause loss of compactness in the limiting process; potential singularities can escape along nested scales.

zh: 平移到任何非零中心后，荷零投影都不与重心操作交换，Euler 场也不再对局部单项式对角。 另外，单位范数见证 \(f_N=(\rho_Z^{-N}Z^N+\rho_W^{-N}W^N)/2\) 满足 \[\|\Phi(f_N)\|_\rho=\frac{3N^2}{4(2N-1)}\to\infty,\] 所以原始二次映射不能在同一 Wiener 半径上直接做 Banach 压缩。
en: After translation to any nonzero center, charge-zero projection no longer commutes with recentering and the Euler fields are no longer diagonal on local monomials. In addition, the unit-norm witness \(f_N=(\rho_Z^{-N}Z^N+\rho_W^{-N}W^N)/2\) satisfies \[\|\Phi(f_N)\|_\rho=\frac{3N^2}{4(2N-1)}\to\infty,\] so the raw quadratic map cannot be treated by a Banach contraction at one fixed Wiener radius.

zh: 普通倍频只产生互不相连的蝶形副本。 我改用整数矩阵 \(M=I+\mathbf1\mathbf1^\top\)，得到精确相邻壳关系 \(c_j+e_j+a_{j+1}=0\)，并证明这条边连同每壳两条内部边就是完整三波超图。
en: ordinary harmonic doubling only produces disconnected butterfly copies. I switched to using an integer matrix \(M=I+\mathbf1\mathbf1^\top\), obtaining precise adjacent shell relations \(c_j+e_j+a_{j+1}=0\), and proved that this edge along with two internal edges in each shell constitutes the complete triad hypergraph.

zh: 普通正平方 tent 是 BMO 侧的 sign-blind 量；两个多壳族又排除了自动尺度 packing。保留下来的候选必须在平方前保留 strain-output 的符号。
en: An ordinary positive-square tent is a sign-blind quantity on the BMO side, and the two multishell families rule out automatic scale packing. Any surviving candidate must retain the sign of the strain output before squaring.

zh: 谱退化能指出方向，高频盲有限标量滤波不能替代全频覆盖
en: Spectral degeneration can identify a direction; high-frequency-blind finite scalar filtering cannot replace all-frequency coverage

zh: 七载频约束唯一写成 \(A+B+C+D-E-F-G=Q\)。七个 Rudin--Shapiro 符号态、 目标符号两态和七个进位构成 \(2\times128\times7=1792\) 个直接状态。四位周期 \(0100\) 的精确秩满足 \[ \operatorname{rank}W_8=204,\qquad \operatorname{rank}W_8^2=\operatorname{rank}W_8^3=148. \]
en: The seven-carrier constraint has the unique form \(A+B+C+D-E-F-G=Q\). Seven Rudin--Shapiro sign bits, two target-sign states, and seven carry values give \(2\times128\times7=1792\) direct states. For the repeated four-bit cycle \(0100\), the exact ranks satisfy \[ \operatorname{rank}W_8=204,\qquad \operatorname{rank}W_8^2=\operatorname{rank}W_8^3=148. \]

zh: 前沿边界
en: frontline boundary

zh: 区间外的 \(c\) 不是数值截断。左尾由零荷列的严格凸性与 负一阶对数导数排除，右尾由活跃矩的正一阶导数与正二阶矩排除。 合并 R0.53 下界后得到 \[ 0.382628602237879637 <r_{\mathrm{prod}}^{\mathrm{opt}} <0.382629. \]
en: Values of \(c\) outside the interval are not numerically truncated. The left tail is excluded by strict convexity and a negative first logarithmic derivative of the zero-charge column; the right tail is excluded by a positive first derivative and positive second moment of the active column. Combining this with the R0.53 lower bound gives \[ 0.382628602237879637 <r_{\mathrm{prod}}^{\mathrm{opt}} <0.382629. \]

zh: 取 \(k=e_2\)，并对 \(N=L,\ldots,2L-1\) 令 \[ p_N=(N,0,0),\qquad q_N=(-N,1,0),\qquad U_{p_N}=c_Ne_2,\quad V_{q_N}=c_Ne_3. \] 则每个正向相互作用贡献 \(c_N^2e_3\)，每个交换相互作用为零， 所以 \[ \mathfrak B_k(U,V)=\left(\sum_Nc_N^2\right)e_3 \] 并精确达到上界。加入共轭伙伴后仍是实值无散场，且没有跨指标 配对落到同一输出。
en: Taking \(k=e_2\) and setting \[ p_N=(N,0,0),\qquad q_N=(-N,1,0),\qquad U_{p_N}=c_Ne_2,\quad V_{q_N}=c_Ne_3. \] for \(N=L,\ldots,2L-1\), each forward interaction contributes \(c_N^2e_3\) and each exchanged interaction is zero, so \[ \mathfrak B_k(U,V)=\left(\sum_Nc_N^2\right)e_3 \] and the upper bound is attained exactly. Adding the conjugate partners still gives a real-valued divergence-free field, and no cross-index pair lands on the same output.

zh: 去混叠 Fourier–Galerkin 实验给出不同结果：阈值上方初值只短暂增加 \(\dot H^{1/2}\) 能量，三线性传递到 \(\tau=0.01\) 已经换号； 到 \(\tau=0.1\)，约 \(84\%\) 的临界能量位于初始支撑之外。
en: go-staggered Fourier–Galerkin experiments give different results: initial data above the threshold only temporarily increase the energy of \(\dot H^{1/2}\), tri-linear transfer to \(\tau=0.01\) has already changed sign; by \(\tau=0.1\), about \(84\%\) of the critical energy is located outside the initial support.

zh: 全部 (16^6) 个自由位移精确压缩为 44,514 个符号类。 正确的无抵消尾使用逐数字传输矩阵的逐项绝对值之积； 合并主根预解式后，完整导数修正不超过 (1.20506130214380835\times10^{-8})。最终严格得到 \[ B_{8,\mathrm{corr}}\in [-2.69744373399132142,-0.287321129703704757] \times10^{-8}<0. \]
en: All (16^6) free shifts compress exactly into 44,514 signature classes. The correct no-cancellation tail uses the product of the entrywise absolute digit-transfer matrices. After the dominant-root resolvent is included, the complete derivative correction is at most (1.20506130214380835 imes10^{-8}). The final rigorous result is \[ B_{8,\mathrm{corr}}\in [-2.69744373399132142,-0.287321129703704757] \times10^{-8}<0. \]

zh: 全部六阶目标路径都具有唯一符号形式 \(A+B+C-D-E=Q\)，并包含十种时间次序。目标符号两态、 五个 Rudin--Shapiro 符号态和五个进位共同给出 \(2\times32\times5=320\) 个直接状态。
en: Every sixth-order target path has the unique sign form \(A+B+C-D-E=Q\), with ten time orderings. Two target-sign states, five Rudin--Shapiro sign states, and five carries give \(2\times32\times5=320\) direct states.

zh: 全部十阶及以上目标项已经联合闭合， 不必再逐阶计算。完整八阶热系数仍未证明；当前数据仍属于全局 光滑的平行剪切不变类，不能推出一般三维正则性。
en: Every target term of order at least ten is now closed jointly, so no further term-by-term calculation is needed. The complete eighth-order heat coefficient remains unproved; the current data still lie in a globally smooth invariant parallel-shear class and do not imply general three-dimensional regularity.

zh: 全部十一阶混合导数与主根质量的严格证书
en: Rigorous certificates for all eleventh-order mixed derivatives and dominant-root masses

zh: 全阶解析主控与共同解析域
en: All-order analytic majorant and common analytic domain

zh: 全阶目标尾归约到唯一八阶关口
en: The all-order target tail reduces to one eighth-order gate

zh: 全阶主控常数从 96 降到 \(81/4\)，并且对数与指数分解不再需要更小的辅助圆盘。
en: The all-order majorant constant drops from 96 to \(81/4\), and the logarithms and exponential factorization no longer require a smaller auxiliary polydisc.

zh: 全局
en: Global

zh: 全局弱解存在
en: the existence of global weak solutions

zh: 全局正则
en: global regularity

zh: 全局正则方向需要控制任意光滑初值的临界范数；有限时破裂方向需要从光滑数据严格构造奇点。
en: The global regularity direction requires controlling the critical norm of arbitrarily smooth initial data; the finite-time blow-up direction necessitates constructing singularities strictly from smooth data.

zh: 全空间欧氏—纵向解析范数的半径损失严格为二阶；普通一阶 Cauchy–Kowalevski 主级数不能在这个空间闭合。
en: The radius loss in the full-space Euclidean–longitudinal analytic norm is exactly second order; the standard first-order Cauchy–Kowalevski majorant series cannot close in this space.

zh: 全六模态泄漏下界与 2D3C 调制
en: lower bound for full six-modal leakage and 2D3C modulation

zh: 全六模态已有显式正泄漏下界；切向调制方程也解释了短时换号。
en: The existing explicit positive leakage lower bound for full six-modal has been established; the tangential modulation equation also explains short-time sign changes.

zh: 缺少排除该临界元的刚性定理。
en: There is a lack of rigid theorem excluding this critical term.

zh: 热流保持耦合，但有限维非线性迅速产生支撑外模态并破坏原相位排列。
en: heat flow maintains coupling, but finite-dimensional nonlinearity rapidly generates support for external modes and disrupts the original phase arrangement.

The certificate gives \(S_r>0\) for \(1\le r\le13\) and \(S_r<0\) for \(14\le r\le24\). The ten consecutive blocks from \(r=15\) through \(r=24\) all satisfy \(|S_r|/|S_{r-1}|>16\), and the final ratio lies strictly in \((25.29,25.30)\).

zh: 任意大但特殊结构的数据可全局；浓缩紧致性将潜在爆破压缩为最小临界对象。
en: arbitrarily large but specially structured data can be global; concentration compactness compresses potential blow-up into minimal critical objects.

zh: 任意实系数多项式背景分别到 43、44、46、45 次仍不能修复四个序列的正测度矩条件；无限解析背景仍未排除。
en: Arbitrary real-coefficient polynomial backgrounds still cannot repair the positive-measure moment conditions for the four series through degrees 43, 44, 46, and 45, respectively; infinite analytic backgrounds remain unexcluded.

zh: 任意张量前缀都被 \(C_T\sqrt{LM}\) 控制，其中 \(C_T=(1+\sqrt2)(2+\sqrt2)\)。同一符号在全部目标配对中满足 \(c_{r,n}^2=1\)。因此热 \(\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}\) 与周期 \(BMO^{-1}\) 的归一化第一迭代比值都有独立于 \(H,L,M\) 的严格正下界。
en: Every tensor prefix is controlled by \(C_T\sqrt{LM}\), where \(C_T=(1+\sqrt2)(2+\sqrt2)\). The same signs satisfy \(c_{r,n}^2=1\) at every target pair. Hence the normalized first-iterate quotients in heat \(\dot B^{-1}_{\infty,\infty}\) and periodic \(BMO^{-1}\) have strict positive lower bounds independent of \(H,L,M\).

zh: 仍然缺失
en: still missing

zh: 仍未解决
en: still unresolved

zh: 如果 Fourier 计算显示原始核允许稳定的单向能量传递，却没有统一的耗散小因子，我会把它记为有限时破裂方向的候选结构。 在得到严格证据之前，我不会根据数值图像判断是否爆破。
en: if Fourier computation shows the original kernel allows stable unidirectional energy transfer, without a unified dissipative small factor, I would record it as a candidate structure for finite-time blow-up in the direction of time. Before obtaining strict evidence, I will not judge whether there is a blow-up based on numerical images.

zh: 如果估计对 Tao averaged 非线性同样成立，它还没有用到解决原问题所需的具体结构。
en: if the estimate holds for Tao averaged nonlinearity as well, it has not yet used the specific structures required to solve the original problem.

zh: 如果前面的工作形成完整结果，我会先请领域专家逐条检查，再投稿同行评议，并记录反例与勘误。
en: if previous work forms complete results, I would first ask domain experts to check each step individually before submitting for peer review and recording counterexamples and corrections.

zh: 如果失败
en: if failure

zh: 如果一个结论依赖额外对称、额外耗散或外力，就把它单独记为相关子问题。
en: if a conclusion depends on additional symmetries, additional dissipation, or external forces, I will record it as a related subproblem separately.

zh: 如果一个论证只用到 \(\langle B(u,u),u\rangle=0\)、双线性算子阶数和一般 Calderón–Zygmund 估计，我会先把它和 averaged Navier–Stokes 的有限时爆破例子比较。 如果同一论证也能推出 averaged 方程全局正则，就说明其中还有一步没有处理好。
en: if an argument only uses \(\langle B(u,u),u\rangle=0\), bilinear operator order, and general Calderón–Zygmund estimates, I would first compare it with finite-time blow-up examples of averaged Navier–Stokes. If the same argument can also lead to global regularity for the averaged equations, it indicates that there is still a step not handled properly.

zh: 如果做到
en: if done

zh: 若 \(u\in L^q_tL^p_x\)，\(2/q+3/p\le1\)、\(p>3\)，则正则且唯一。
en: if \(u\in L^q_tL^p_x\), then \(2/q+3/p\le1\) and \(p>3\) regular and unique.

zh: 若存在有限时爆破，利用 profile decomposition 抽取最小临界解；证明它必须具有步骤 4 排除的结构。
en: if there is a finite-time blow-up, use profile decomposition to extract the minimal critical solution; prove that it must have the structure excluded in step 4.

zh: 若某些临界空间中存在爆破解，可抽取最小爆破轮廓。
en: if there are blow-up solutions in some critical spaces, one can extract the minimal blow-up profile.

zh: 若一个范数在该缩放下不变，就称为尺度临界。典型临界量包括 \(L^3_x\)、\(\dot H^{1/2}_x\)、\(\dot B^{-1+3/p}_{p,q}\) 和 \(L^q_tL^p_x\)（满足 \(2/q+3/p=1\)）。基本能量 \(\|u\|_{L^2}\) 在高频缩放下变小，因而对三维正则性是超临界控制： 它允许能量在越来越小的空间尺度上集中。
en: if a norm remains unchanged under this scaling, it is called scale-critical. Typical critical quantities include \(L^3_x\), \(\dot H^{1/2}_x\), \(\dot B^{-1+3/p}_{p,q}\), and \(L^q_tL^p_x\) (satisfying \(2/q+3/p=1\)). The basic energy \(\|u\|_{L^2}\) shrinks under high-frequency scaling, thus being supercritical for three-dimensional regularity: it allows energy to concentrate on increasingly smaller spatial scales.

zh: 弱解非唯一性改变了什么
en: what does the non-uniqueness of weak solutions change

zh: 三变量切向方程在 \(\tau=0.07013\) 使标量振幅换号；稠密 Galerkin 轨道在 \(0.06782\) 换号。 离平面模态仍保持有利传递，所以它们延迟、但没有阻止平面核心的反转。
en: the three-variable tangential equations in \(\tau=0.07013\) cause scalar amplitude sign changes; dense Galerkin orbits in \(0.06782\) also change signs. Planar modal states still favor beneficial transfer, so they delay but do not prevent the reversal of the planar core.

zh: 三变量驻点的 Krawczyk 证书
en: the Krawczyk certificate for three-variable stationary points

zh: 三波核 → 近对角包 → 短时泄漏 → 非共面网络
en: Triad kernel → near-diagonal packet → short-time leakage → non-coplanar network

zh: 三个一维 Leray 像可以组成不退化的前向接力，但等长三波门无法同时保持差频消失和一维反向闭合。
en: three one-dimensional Leray projections can form an non-degenerate forward relay, but equal-length triad gates cannot simultaneously maintain the vanishing of the beat frequency and one-dimensional backward closure.

zh: 三个异常荷 \(s=-1,0,1\) 继承 R0.39 的精确列，\(s\ge241\) 继承解析大荷扇区；三部分覆盖每个输入荷和每个 \(j>80\)。 R0.40 预先留下的 \(257/1000\) 失败点现在以主动尾界 \(0.6804858814\) 与输运界 \(0.8672869049\) 严格通过。
en: The three exceptional charges \(s=-1,0,1\) retain the exact R0.39 columns, while \(s\ge241\) retains the analytic large-charge sector; together the three pieces cover every input charge and every \(j>80\). The preassigned R0.40 failure at \(257/1000\) now passes strictly with active-tail bound \(0.6804858814\) and transport bound \(0.8672869049\).

zh: 三个正模态的能量传递为 \((2,-3,1)\)，总和为零； 乘上频率平方后的 enstrophy 传递为 \((2,-3,2)\)，总和为一。 加上共轭模态后，直接 Fourier 计算给出 \[ \int_{\mathbb T^3}\omega\cdot S\omega\,dx=2. \] 尖锐输出壳分解中只有 \(\mathcal F_0=2\)，所以 \(\Gamma=|\sum_m\mathcal F_m|/\sum_m|\mathcal F_m|=1\)。
en: The three positive modes have energy transfers \((2,-3,1)\), whose sum is zero. After multiplication by squared frequency, their enstrophy transfers are \((2,-3,2)\), whose sum is one. Including the conjugate modes, direct Fourier calculation gives \[ \int_{\mathbb T^3}\omega\cdot S\omega\,dx=2. \] Only \(\mathcal F_0=2\) is active in the sharp output-shell decomposition, so \(\Gamma=|\sum_m\mathcal F_m|/\sum_m|\mathcal F_m|=1\).

zh: 三类六叶树和五种根分裂已有精确闭式；在固定极化、等幅同相族内，同阶外部能量至少为目标的 45.739 倍。
en: exact closed forms for three classes of six-leaf trees and five root splits have been obtained; in a fixed polarization, equal-amplitude in-phase families, at least 45.739 times the external energy is targeted.

zh: 三门极化接力与反向边障碍
en: the three-gate polarization relay with backward edge obstacles

zh: 三维 Navier–Stokes 千禧年问题 · 个人研究笔记
en: 3D Navier–Stokes Millennium Problem · Personal Research Notes

zh: 三维 Navier–Stokes 全局正则性问题
en: The 3D Navier–Stokes Global Regularity Problem

zh: 三维 Navier–Stokes 全局正则性问题｜个人研究记录
en: The 3D Navier–Stokes Global Regularity Problem | Personal Research Notes

zh: 三维 NS 的 Leray–Hopf 非唯一性的严格计算机辅助证明。 这是极重要的前沿信号，但截至本综述日期仍应标为预印本主张，不能等同于已经过同行评议和独立复核的定理； 即使该结论被确认，它讨论的也是粗糙初值与弱解唯一性，不自动解决 Clay 要求的光滑初值全局光滑性。
en: a rigorous computer-assisted proof of the non-uniqueness of Leray–Hopf weak solutions for three-dimensional NS. This is a crucial front signal, but as of the date of this review, it should still be marked as a preprint claim and not equivalent to a theorem that has been peer-reviewed and independently verified; even if this conclusion is confirmed, it discusses rough initial data and weak solution uniqueness, which does not automatically solve Clay's requirement for global smoothness with smooth initial data.

zh: 三维不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 方程为
en: the three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations are

zh: 三维根盒的每个坐标宽度均为 \(10^{-40}\)。精确 Krawczyk 像严格落在盒内，因此盒中恰有一个同时根；两个 KKT 乘子为正， LICQ 子式下界大于 \(261.21\)，临界切向曲率下界大于 \(1825.13\)，所以该根是严格约束局部最大点。除两个活跃约束外， 242 个有限或无穷扇区全部严格低于一。
en: Each coordinate of the three-dimensional root box has width \(10^{-40}\). The exact Krawczyk image lies strictly inside, so the box contains exactly one simultaneous root. Both KKT multipliers are positive, the LICQ minor has lower bound greater than \(261.21\), and the critical-tangent curvature has lower bound greater than \(1825.13\); hence the root is a strict constrained local maximum. Apart from the two active constraints, all 242 finite or infinite sectors are strictly below one.

zh: 三叶端点增量给出精确二维恒等式 \(U_{N+1}=T_NU_N+R_N\)。 但 \(T_N^a\to\operatorname{diag}(-24t,-24t)\)，\(T_N^b\to\operatorname{diag}(-24t,16t)\)， 且 \(24t=11.9010\ldots>1\)；孤立传递并不收缩，带符号余项也不是小扰动。
en: The three-leaf endpoint increments give the exact two-dimensional identity \(U_{N+1}=T_NU_N+R_N\). But \(T_N^a\to\operatorname{diag}(-24t,-24t)\), \(T_N^b\to\operatorname{diag}(-24t,16t)\), and \(24t=11.9010\ldots>1\); the isolated transfer is not contractive, and the signed remainder is not a small perturbation.

zh: 三组确定性扫描共包含 464 次计算、461 个不同 \((L,M,m)\) 三元组、 49 个参数对与 7,494,536,238 条有序四次路径。所有观测到的 \(R_{L,M,m}\) 均为正，最大值约为 \(1.3286563\times10^{-3}\)， 位于 \((4,64,64)\)。60 位独立复算与 long-double 结果的相对差低于 \(5.6\times10^{-15}\)。
en: The three deterministic scans comprise 464 evaluations, 461 distinct \((L,M,m)\) triples, 49 parameter pairs, and 7,494,536,238 ordered quartic paths. Every observed \(R_{L,M,m}\) is positive, with maximum about \(1.3286563\times10^{-3}\) at \((4,64,64)\). The independent 60-digit recomputation differs from the long-double result by less than \(5.6\times10^{-15}\) relatively.
Previous review v0.86 · 2026-08-25

zh: 尚未解决
en: still unsolved

zh: 设 \(\eta_{\rm KT}^{\rm per}\) 是周期 Koch–Tataru 小数据 定理的一个允许阈值。对充分大的 \(r\)，所有满足 \[ (6+4\sqrt{2})\rho^r+ \|w_{0,r}\|_{BMO^{-1}_{\rm per}} <\eta_{\rm KT}^{\rm per} \] 的真正三维横向扰动都产生全局正则解。允许扰动球的半径不随 \(r\) 缩小，因此任何仍未排除的奇性路径必须付出常数量级的 临界范数代价。
en: Let \(\eta_{\rm KT}^{\rm per}\) be an admissible threshold for the periodic Koch–Tataru small-data theorem. For all sufficiently large \(r\), every genuinely three-dimensional transverse perturbation satisfying \[ (6+4\sqrt{2})\rho^r+ \|w_{0,r}\|_{BMO^{-1}_{\rm per}} <\eta_{\rm KT}^{\rm per} \] produces a globally regular solution. The allowed perturbation radius does not shrink with \(r\), so every singularity route not yet excluded must pay an order-one critical-norm cost.

zh: 十一阶在 \(N\ge5\) 时首次具有显式零平面支撑路径，但这不证明 完整系数非零。三次项仍可回到原始高频 \(V\) 支撑，并与二次项 共同满足精确四阶能量恒等式。因此第一处可能改变 R0.59 低频目标 的项是 \(G_4\)，不是 \(G_3\)。
en: Order eleven has the first explicit zero-plane support path when \(N\ge5\), but this does not prove that the full coefficient is nonzero. The cubic term can still return to the original high-frequency \(V\) support and, together with the quadratic term, satisfies the exact fourth-order energy identity. Therefore \(G_4\), not \(G_3\), is the first term that can change the R0.59 low-frequency target.

zh: 时间层因式分解和提升递推是全指标代数 恒等式；六个压力测试只是有限证据。当前仍未证明 \(|S_{4,m}|\le CL^2M\)，也没有进入一般三维流。
en: The time-layer factorization and lifted recursion are all-index algebraic identities; the six stress tests are finite evidence. The estimate \(|S_{4,m}|\le CL^2M\) is still unproved, and the analysis has not reached general three-dimensional flow.

zh: 时间分层因式分解与提升 Rudin--Shapiro 递推
en: Time-layer factorization and the lifted Rudin--Shapiro recursion

zh: 实振幅全局最优是等幅同相；任意复振幅的外部/目标比被严格夹在 45.739348 与 45.739348964728 之间。
en: real amplitude global optimality is equal-amplitude in-phase; the external/target ratio for arbitrary complex amplitudes is strictly bounded between 45.739348 and 45.739348964728.

zh: 适当弱解的奇异集一维抛物 Hausdorff 测度为零。
en: the singular set of an appropriate weak solution has one-dimensional parabolic Hausdorff measure zero.

zh: 首个完整八阶热块与六变量八次主 jet
en: The first complete eighth-order heat block and the six-variable degree-eight dominant jet

zh: 首周期正号已经严格闭合； 八次主 jet 已完整计算并归档，但还需把零八次 jet 缺陷的 预解式修正与完整热函数的九阶导数乘积压到主信号之下。 当前平行剪切类本身全局光滑，不能推出一般三维正则性。
en: The positive first-cycle sign is rigorously closed. The degree-eight dominant jet has been fully computed and archived, but the product of the degree-zero-to-eight jet-defect resolvent correction and the ninth derivative of the complete heat function must still be driven below the dominant signal. The present parallel-shear class is itself globally smooth and cannot imply general three-dimensional regularity.

zh: 受保护的 IEEE binary128 矩提升封闭了总阶十以内的 14,350,336 个矩坐标。随后，35 个时间次序、6,055 个 精确有理项和统一无穷尾界给出十阶热 jet： \[ B_{10}\in[-1.49238243184751323,-1.49238243184751290] \times10^{-8}. \]
en: The guarded IEEE binary128 moment lift encloses 14,350,336 moment coordinates through total degree ten. Next, 35 time orderings, 6,055 exact rational terms, and a uniform infinite-tail bound give the degree-ten heat jet: \[ B_{10}\in[-1.49238243184751323,-1.49238243184751290] \times10^{-8}. \]

All 242 sectors with input charge \(s=-1,0,\ldots,240\) are bounded exactly; the infinite large-charge sector \(s\ge241\) is uniformly closed by the analytic endpoint bound over \(s/j\in[0,2]\). At \(N=80\) and \(r_*=397/2000\), the R0.38 scalar tail bound is \(2.0387665>1\), while the new charge-resolved tail bound is \(0.6896011<1\).

zh: 双壳五阶展开与完整频率回路
en: bivalve fifth-order expansion with complete frequency loops

zh: 双增量环带重构与仿射核心边界载荷是严格恒等式；0.996478 是一个显式截断场、核心限制积分的随机化准蒙特卡洛结果，不是区间证明、全空间环带比值或普适耗减定理。它是对强静态跨尺度抵消的不利证据，不构成正则性结论。
en: The double-increment annular reconstruction and affine-core boundary loading are rigorous identities; 0.996478 is a randomized quasi-Monte Carlo result for an explicit truncated field and a core-restricted integral, not an interval proof, a whole-space annular ratio, or a universal depletion theorem. It is evidence against strong static cross-scale cancellation, not a regularity conclusion.

zh: 双振幅全局优化与复相位 Bernstein 界
en: dual-amplitude global optimization and complex phase Bernstein boundEND

zh: 说明
en: formal problem statement

zh: 四次热核路径和已在每个时间层精确化为加权多项式系数。两态符号递推的三次乘积闭合在八态；加入目标符号后是十六态并传递进位。所需一致界现在被准确化为非自治提升算子的积分范数问题。
en: At each time layer, the quartic heat-kernel path sum is reduced exactly to weighted polynomial coefficients. The cubic product of the two-state sign recursion closes on eight states; adding the target sign gives sixteen states and transports carries. The desired uniform bound is now identified precisely as an integrated-norm problem for a non-autonomous lifted operator.

zh: 四次相关分解与全指标平方根上界
en: Quartic correlation reduction and all-index square-root bound

zh: 四个精确负 Hankel 主子式排除了反号输运序列及其对数导数的直接正测度 Stieltjes/Markov 表示；该结论不否定 R0.32 候选。
en: Four exact negative Hankel principal minors exclude direct positive-measure Stieltjes/Markov representations for the sign-transformed transport series and their logarithmic derivatives; this conclusion does not refute the R0.32 candidate.

zh: 四个完整边界的精确 Bernstein 符号与 Poincaré–Miranda 定理给出同时零点，并把它隔离在 \[ 0.382619813709565<r_*<0.382619813709566, \] \[ 0.8024563827<c_*<0.8024563828. \] 严格凸性、强制性和半径单调性随后证明：这是整个 \(c>0\) 上唯一的全局阈值最大值，不是采样网格上的局部峰值。
en: Exact Bernstein signs on all four complete faces and the Poincaré–Miranda theorem give a simultaneous zero and isolate it in \[ 0.382619813709565<r_*<0.382619813709566, \] \[ 0.8024563827<c_*<0.8024563828. \] Strict convexity, coercivity, and radius monotonicity then prove that this is the unique global threshold maximum over all \(c>0\), not a local peak on a sampling grid.

zh: 四类近对角 helicity 核已有闭式公式、零点集和解析极值。
en: Four classes of near-diagonal helicity kernels already have closed-form formulas, zero sets, and analytic extrema.

zh: 四十阶 GMP 重构处理 68,664 次有序相互作用。R0.31 全阶系数主控给出外尾界 \(1.8052322\times10^{-8}\)、内包含半径 \(9.8990066\times10^{-29}\) 与残差上界 \(5.3934098\times10^{-8}\)。有限多项式的精确残差约 \(2.4184\times10^{-75}\)， 但这个更小数值没有被当作无穷尾界。
en: The degree-40 GMP reconstruction processes 68,664 ordered interactions. The R0.31 all-order coefficient majorant gives the outer tail bound \(1.8052322\times10^{-8}\), inner inclusion radius \(9.8990066\times10^{-29}\), and residual upper bound \(5.3934098\times10^{-8}\). The finite polynomial has exact residual about \(2.4184\times10^{-75}\), but this smaller value is not used as an infinite-tail bound.

The image space of the four-bit cycle \(0100\) has dimension 36. The exact characteristic polynomial, Schur disk, and absence of generating-function cancellation together prove \[ Y_r=C_{6,0}\mu^r+O(300^r),\qquad 402.425429345624<\mu<402.4254293456256, \] with \(-0.013063396815425<C_{6,0}<-0.013063396815144\). Hence \(|Y_r|/256^r\to\infty\).

zh: 速度生成的双重散度结构带来尖锐的 \(R^{-5}\) 远场界
en: The velocity-generated double-divergence structure yields a sharp \(R^{-5}\) far-field bound

zh: 随后利用 \(\mathcal T(S[v])=0\) 得到精确截断交换子，把近场压力改写成 \[ r^3|\mathcal P_{v,r}| \le C_qX_q(D_A^{1/2}+\sigma_A+\mu_A). \] 这移除了过强的 \(L^2\) 压力源范数，并保留过渡项与 \(2^{-5m}\) 远场增益。17 项形式检查全部通过。
en: Using \(\mathcal T(S[v])=0\) then gives an exact cutoff commutator and rewrites the near pressure as \[ r^3|\mathcal P_{v,r}| \le C_qX_q(D_A^{1/2}+\sigma_A+\mu_A). \] This removes the overly strong \(L^2\) pressure-source norm while preserving the transition term and the \(2^{-5m}\) far-field gain. All 17 formal checks passed.

zh: 所得一个实值无散初值完全位于 \(H\le|\xi|<2H\)。它的完整第一 Picard 二次项只剩 \(U\cdot\nabla V\)。投影到 \(\xi_1=0\) 后， 对每个 \(1\le m\le M\) 精确得到 \[ d_m(t)=m e^{-m^2t}\sum_{n=0}^{L-1} \frac{1-e^{-2R_{m-1,n}^2t}}{2R_{m-1,n}^2}, \] 且在 \(t_H=(\log2)/(2H^2)\) 有 \(2mL/(25H^2)<d_m(t_H)\le mL/(2H^2)\)。
en: The resulting real divergence-free datum is supported entirely in \(H\le|\xi|<2H\). Its complete first Picard quadratic term leaves only \(U\cdot\nabla V\). After projection to \(\xi_1=0\), for each \(1\le m\le M\) one obtains exactly \[ d_m(t)=m e^{-m^2t}\sum_{n=0}^{L-1} \frac{1-e^{-2R_{m-1,n}^2t}}{2R_{m-1,n}^2}, \] and at \(t_H=(\log2)/(2H^2)\), \(2mL/(25H^2)<d_m(t_H)\le mL/(2H^2)\).

en: Condition results

en: Conditions must be expressed in terms of evolvable quantities and cannot include the critical norm boundedness as an assumption to be proven.

zh: 通道分层与条件上界是严格代数结论；\(N=4,5\) 只是有限高精度证据。 尚未证明所有 \(N\) 的尖锐坐标衰减，普通正值主控量也不能提供完整系数所需的带符号下界。
en: The channel hierarchy and conditional upper bound are rigorous algebraic conclusions; \(N=4,5\) provide only finite high-precision evidence. Decay of the sharp coordinates for every \(N\) remains unproved, and an ordinary positive majorant cannot supply the signed lower bound required for the full coefficient.

zh: 通用 paraproduct 估计不足以闭合临界能量。我想检查：无散条件、Leray 投影、 三个波数的几何关系和实值共轭对称性，是否使危险的 high–high、high–low 相互作用获得 一个可求和的小因子。如果它存在，应当来自原始 NS 的具体结构，而不是只依赖抽象的能量抵消。
en: General paraproduct estimates are insufficient to close the critical energy. I want to check if the divergence-free condition, Leray projection, geometric relations among three wavenumbers, and real-valued conjugate symmetry make dangerous high–high, high–low interactions obtain a summable small factor. If it exists, it should come from the specific structure of the original NS rather than just relying on abstract energy cancellation.

zh: 同号类的临界加权传递恒为零。三个异号类的最大值分别为 \(\sqrt{15}/16\) 和两个共同的 \(0.635456473486601\)。 因此，单三元组几何不能给全部螺旋类提供统一小因子。
en: Same-sign class critical weighted transfer is zero. The maximum values for three opposite-sign classes are \(\sqrt{15}/16\) and two common \(0.635456473486601\) respectively. Therefore, single triad geometry cannot provide a uniform small factor for all helical classes.

zh: 同一半径上的全阶主动尾界为 \(0.9978571914<1\)，球映射、Lipschitz 与指数重构均严格闭合。 下一千分位点 \(0.330\) 的当前主动尾充分界为 \(1.0028721509>1\)，证明边界已移回继承的大荷主动扇区。
en: At the same radius, the all-order active-tail bound is \(0.9978571914<1\), and the ball map, Lipschitz condition, and exponential reconstruction all close strictly. At the next millesimal point \(0.330\), the present active-tail sufficient bound is \(1.0028721509>1\), moving the proof boundary back to the inherited large-charge active sector.

zh: 同一源与形状，压力仍能翻转导数
en: Same source and shape, yet pressure can still reverse the derivative

The same true \(s=162,j=81\) column remains dominant. Its unique positive root is isolated in \[ 0.382618642388680778<r_*^{(4/5)}<0.382618642388680779. \] All 243 competitors are strictly smaller throughout the adjacent-millionth window; the nearest remains \(s=164\), with strict gap \(1.4157274652\times10^{-4}\).

zh: 同一族的完整场满足 \(u_R(x)=R u_1(x/R)\)，从而全空间双增量环带满足 \[ \mathcal A_{m+k}(u_R)=R^3\mathcal A_k(u_1), \qquad\Gamma_{\rm ann}(u_R)=\Gamma_{\rm ann}(u_1). \] 这条缩放障碍同样严格：把同一截断形状推远只能让核心观测量饱和，不能制造全空间饱和族。19 项符号检查全部通过；另以 29,360,128 组 scrambled-Sobol 点对审计七个有限二进半径，数值过渡与解析极限一致。
en: The complete field in the same family satisfies \(u_R(x)=R u_1(x/R)\), so the full-space double-increment annuli obey \[ \mathcal A_{m+k}(u_R)=R^3\mathcal A_k(u_1), \qquad\Gamma_{\rm ann}(u_R)=\Gamma_{\rm ann}(u_1). \] This scaling obstruction is equally rigorous: moving the same cutoff shape outward can saturate the core observable but cannot create a full-space saturating family. All 19 symbolic checks passed; 29,360,128 scrambled-Sobol point pairs also audited seven finite dyadic radii, and the numerical transition agrees with the analytic limits.

zh: 完整 Duhamel 时间积分给出精确的 \(N^{-2}\) 热分母。它在固定块、\(\mathcal X^{-1}\) 与 \(\dot H^{1/2}\) 中分别产生 \(L^{-2}\)、\(L^{-1}\)、\(L^{-3}\) 壳衰减；但 Rudin--Shapiro 相位压平使热 Besov 与周期 \(BMO^{-1}\) 的归一化比值保持常数阶。
en: The full Duhamel time integral produces the exact \(N^{-2}\) heat denominator. In the fixed block, \(\mathcal X^{-1}\), and \(\dot H^{1/2}\), it yields shell decay of \(L^{-2}\), \(L^{-1}\), and \(L^{-3}\), respectively; but Rudin--Shapiro phase flattening keeps the normalized ratios in heat Besov and periodic \(BMO^{-1}\) at constant order.

zh: 完整 Fourier--Leray 项有有限的尺度临界标量次数上界；一个显式高—高到低族在任意大的输入/输出尺度分离下仍精确饱和；卷积可加且旋转不变的实标量荷只能恒为零。
en: The full Fourier--Leray term has a finite scale-critical scalar degree upper bound; an explicit high--high-to-low family remains exactly saturating at arbitrarily large input/output scale separation; every real scalar charge that is convolution-additive and rotation-invariant must vanish identically.

zh: 完整乘积仿射族的全局窄区间
en: A narrow global interval for the complete product-affine family

zh: 完整乘积仿射族的最优半径被压入 \(0.382628602237879637<r_{\mathrm{prod}}^{\mathrm{opt}}<0.382629\)。精确角色尾部与 14 叶连续覆盖排除了上端半径的全部参数；相对 R0.53 见证的剩余潜在改进小于约 \(1.0396\) ppm。
en: The optimal radius of the complete product-affine family is confined to \(0.382628602237879637<r_{\mathrm{prod}}^{\mathrm{opt}}<0.382629\). Exact character tails and a 14-leaf continuous cover exclude every parameter at the upper-end radius; the remaining potential improvement over the R0.53 witness is below about \(1.0396\) ppm.

zh: 完整大正荷正和保留同一个 \(x=s/j\) 后成为凸函数，只需两个端点；共同半径从 0.330 推进到 0.370，下一失败转移到有限荷 \(s=-1\)。
en: After retaining the same \(x=s/j\), the complete positive large-charge sum becomes convex and needs only two endpoints; the common radius advances from 0.330 to 0.370, and the next failure moves to the finite charge \(s=-1\).

zh: 完整多项式列关于共同斜率 \(x=s/j\in[-1,2]\) 为凸函数，所以两个真实端点同时覆盖每个输入次数和荷；严格主动尾在端点只增加 \(1\) 与 \(163/243\) 两个解析乘子。 预定验收点 \(0.282\) 的新伸缩界为 \(0.5817058428<1\)，在 \(r_*=329/1000\) 上则为 \(0.7633728925<1\)。
en: The complete polynomial column is convex in the common slope \(x=s/j\in[-1,2]\), so the two genuine endpoints cover every input degree and charge simultaneously; the strict active tail adds only the two analytic endpoint multipliers \(1\) and \(163/243\). At the preassigned acceptance point \(0.282\), the new stretch bound is \(0.5817058428<1\), while at \(r_*=329/1000\) it is \(0.7633728925<1\).

en: The full quadratic feedback is closed; the remaining gate is the reference critical resolvent

en: A narrow global enclosure for the complete affine charge-weight family

zh: 完整仿射族的最优半径已被压入宽 \(10^{-40}\) 的有理区间。三维同时根由精确 Krawczyk 包含隔离，正 KKT 乘子与二阶条件确定严格局部极大类型，242 个非活跃对象全部保留严格间隙；消元后的 316 次多项式把整个 \(c>0,\lambda\ge0\) 参数域排除在上端半径之外。
en: The optimal radius of the complete affine family is enclosed in a rational interval of width \(10^{-40}\). Exact Krawczyk inclusion isolates the three-dimensional simultaneous root, positive KKT multipliers and the second-order condition determine its strict local-maximum type, and all 242 inactive objects retain strict gaps. The eliminated degree-316 polynomial excludes the entire \(c>0,\lambda\ge0\) parameter domain at the upper radius.

zh: 完整复现局部强解、能量估计、弱–强唯一性、Serrin 准则和一个 \(\varepsilon\)-正则性命题。
en: Fully reproduce local strong solutions, energy estimates, weak–strong uniqueness, Serrin criterion, and a \(\varepsilon\)-regularity theorem.

zh: 完整精确残差约为 \(1.7707\times10^{-51}\)，球映射与 Lipschitz 条件严格通过。 精细输运界为 \(0.99941043<1\)，而附近探针 \(199/1000\) 的输运界为 \(1.00254286>1\)。因此共同半径相对 R0.38 增长约 1.6822 倍，固定荷半径增长约 4.7603 倍。
en: The complete exact residual is approximately \(1.7707\times10^{-51}\), and the ball-mapping and Lipschitz conditions pass rigorously. The refined transport bound is \(0.99941043<1\), while the nearby probe \(199/1000\) has transport bound \(1.00254286>1\). Thus the common radius grows by about 1.6822 relative to R0.38, and the fixed-charge radius grows by about 4.7603.

en: The complete frame repairs the observational gap, while successive counterexamples reduce the covariance route to signed common response

en: The full three-dimensional system reduces exactly to a plane-parallel shear system for this packet; cubic target return is impossible, odd orders three through nine cannot reach \(\xi_1=0\), and the first possible target correction is quartic.

zh: 完整输运列和的凸性把全部输入斜率归约到两个真实端点，次数单调性再把全部输入次数归约到 \(j=1\)；共同解析半径提高到 \(32/125\)。
en: The convexity of complete transport column sums reduces all input slopes to two real endpoints, while degree monotonicity further reduces all input degrees to \(j=1\); the common analytic radius is increased to \(32/125\).

zh: 完整四次目标系数已化为显式合流热核路径和。有限扫描覆盖 461 个不同三元组和约 74.95 亿条有序路径，全部观测到反相修正且未见随 \(M\) 增长；全指标一致界仍待证明。
en: The complete quartic target coefficient is reduced to an explicit confluent heat-kernel path sum. A finite scan of 461 distinct triples and about 7.495 billion ordered paths finds opposite-phase corrections throughout and no growth with \(M\); an all-index uniform bound remains unproved.

en: The homogeneous Taylor coefficients of the complete five-simplex kernel are computed through degree 32 by an integer recurrence, \(T=\operatorname{atanh}(1/3)\) is enclosed by a positive rational series, and the omitted tail has absolute upper bound below \(1.944\times10^{-12}\). The final result is \[ 0.0516697551544 <S_{6,q}^{(M=16)} <0.0516697551584. \]

zh: 完整五阶 Fourier 递推显示，外部频率路径会回到下一壳目标并压倒指定接力，但同阶约 98% 的临界能量仍位于目标之外。
en: Full fifth-order Fourier recursion shows that external frequency paths return to the next shell target and overwhelm specified relays, but about 98% of critical energy remains outside the target.

en: Root box certificate for full five-dimensional Hessian

en: Prepare a set of error-checking baselines for subsequent calculations and see where known proofs lose control.

zh: 未加权四点相关被精确分成三个进位通道，并证明所有 dyadic 指标上的四次比值满足 \(|R_{L,M,m}|\le7.8343(m/M)^2\sqrt M\)。这个上界消除了全部 \(L\) 增长，但一致界仍差一个平方根因子。
en: The unweighted four-point correlation is reduced exactly to three carry channels, and the quartic ratio is proved to satisfy \(|R_{L,M,m}|\le7.8343(m/M)^2\sqrt M\) for every dyadic index. This removes all \(L\)-growth, but a uniform bound is still missing one square-root factor.

en: vorticity direction criterion
