en: vorticity stretching of indeterminate sign

zh: 我把 \(b_r\)、\(N_r\) 与 \(B_\infty=\sum_{m\ge2}2^{-5m}e_m\) 逐项对照适当弱解能量空间、CKN、临界 \(L^3\)、局部压力投影和 Morrey 判据。 对中心固定的临界动能 Morrey 包络 \[ \mathfrak M_2(r)=\sup_{\rho\ge4r}\rho^{-1} \int_{B_\rho}|u|^2, \] 五次幂壳层权重给出 \[ B_\infty(r)\le\frac1{120}\mathfrak M_2(r). \] 单壳见证同时证明不存在反向统一常数。
en: I compare \(b_r\), \(N_r\), and \(B_\infty=\sum_{m\ge2}2^{-5m}e_m\) term by term with the suitable-weak-solution energy space, CKN, critical \(L^3\), local pressure projection, and Morrey criteria. For the centered critical kinetic Morrey envelope \[ \mathfrak M_2(r)=\sup_{\rho\ge4r}\rho^{-1} \int_{B_\rho}|u|^2, \] the fifth-power shell weight gives \[ B_\infty(r)\le\frac1{120}\mathfrak M_2(r). \] A single-shell witness also proves that no uniform reverse constant exists.

zh: 我把 \(X_T\) 改写成一个首段 \(X_\tau\) 临界块和一个 正时间加权 \(L^\infty\) 块。两个范数在有限区间上等价， 而参考线性化算子在这个分解中恰好是下三角 Volterra 算子。 定义 \[ a=2C_B\|v\|_{X_\tau},\qquad b_\lambda=2C_S \sup_{\tau\le t\le T}\|v(t)\|_\infty \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{\lambda}}. \] 若 \(a,b_\lambda<1\)，则 \[ \mathfrak M_v(T) \le \frac{ 1+\sqrt{27} +e^{\lambda(T-\tau)} \left(\sqrt{T/\tau}+\min\{1,\sqrt T\}/\sqrt\tau\right) }{(1-a)(1-b_\lambda)}. \]
en: I rewrite \(X_T\) as an initial \(X_\tau\) critical block and a positive-time weighted \(L^\infty\) block. The two norms are equivalent on a finite interval, and the reference linearization is exactly a lower-triangular Volterra operator in this decomposition. Define \[ a=2C_B\|v\|_{X_\tau},\qquad b_\lambda=2C_S \sup_{\tau\le t\le T}\|v(t)\|_\infty \sqrt{\frac{\pi}{\lambda}}. \] If \(a,b_\lambda<1\), then \[ \mathfrak M_v(T) \le \frac{ 1+\sqrt{27} +e^{\lambda(T-\tau)} \left(\sqrt{T/\tau}+\min\{1,\sqrt T\}/\sqrt\tau\right) }{(1-a)(1-b_\lambda)}. \]

zh: 我把 R0.12 的浮点极限改写为有理 Laurent 递推。 完整第五阶目标只有三类六叶计数，其系数分别为 \(1273\sqrt6/1120\)、\(45251\sqrt6/1120\) 和 \(1273\sqrt6/1120\)，所以总系数恰为 \(47797\sqrt6/1120\)。
en: I rewrote the floating-point limit of R0.12 as a rational Laurent recursion. The complete fifth-order target has only three six-leaf counts, whose coefficients are respectively \(1273\sqrt6/1120\), \(45251\sqrt6/1120\), and \(1273\sqrt6/1120\), so the total coefficient is exactly \(47797\sqrt6/1120\).

zh: 我把 R0.14 的单位立方体分成一个含代数极小点的小有理盒及其补集。 小盒内，轴向二阶导数严格大于 \(26745\)，横向差商的 288 个 Bernstein 系数给出 \(J\ge5420\)；补集上，24 个叶盒证明更强的有理界 \(X/T\ge45.739349\)。
en: I divide the unit cube with R0.14 into a small rational box containing an algebraic minimum point and its complement. Inside the small box, the axial second derivatives are strictly greater than \(26745\); the 288 Bernstein coefficients of the lateral divided differences give \(J\ge5420\); on the complement, 24 leaf boxes prove a stronger rational bound \(X/T\ge45.739349\).

I separate the pump and catalytic cone parameters in R0.16 that share a search scale. The fine rational points \(m=429/2500\), \(n=4271/10000\), \(x=26213/10000\) provide the external/target ratio \(15.801443619697901\ldots\) and the target energy ratio as \(5.951869509758118\ldots\%\).

zh: 我把 R0.19 的局部极值问题扩展到整个正参数闭包 \([0,\infty]^3\)。两个半径 \(10^{-6}\) 的有理 Krawczyk 盒分别认证一个严格局部最大点和一个非退化鞍点； 根盒与两个精确边界条带之外的全局 Bernstein 细分以零未决盒结束。
en: I extended the R0.19 local-extremum problem to the full positive-parameter closure \([0,\infty]^3\). Two rational Krawczyk boxes of radius \(10^{-6}\) certify a strict local maximum and a nondegenerate saddle point. The global Bernstein subdivision outside the root boxes and two exact boundary strips ends with no undecided boxes.

zh: 我把 R0.20 的第五阶有限模型放回带热算子的时间 Taylor 递推。 在半径 \(10^{-6}\) 的全局最优根盒上，六阶与七阶目标修正相对五阶的严格区间分别为 \([-2.6112769164,-2.6112696484]\) 与 \([-2.81447044,-2.81441437]\)。
en: I place the fifth-order finite model with $R^{0.20}$ back into the time Taylor expansion with the heat operator in the radius of analyticity. \(10^{-6}\) on the global optimal root box, the strict intervals for sixth and seventh order target corrections relative to fifth order are \([-2.6112769164,-2.6112696484]\) commutes with the operator \([-2.81447044,-2.81441437]\).

zh: 我把 R0.22 的标签族放回 R0.20 优化初值生成的完整纯非线性 Taylor 递推。 在有理根中心，归一化只引入一个二次域生成元；因此十阶以内的非零、极化投影和根分裂相消都用精确有理代数判定。
en: I placed the family of R0.22 labels back into the complete pure nonlinear Taylor recursion generated from rational root optimized initial data. At the center of rational roots, normalization introduces only one quadratic generator; thus, polarization projections and root splitting cancellations up to tenth order are exactly determined by precise rational algebra.

zh: 我把 R0.30 的卷积核分成精确有限段和解析尾段。GMP 有理数覆盖 \(3\le L\le296\)，最大值是 \(H_3=27/4\)； 对 \(L\ge297\)，递减上界 \(10000/2187+640/L+1600/L^2\) 已严格低于 \(27/4\)。
en: I split the R0.30 convolution kernel into an exact finite segment and an analytic tail segment. GMP rationals cover \(3\le L\le296\), with maximum \(H_3=27/4\); for \(L\ge297\), the decreasing bound \(10000/2187+640/L+1600/L^2\) is already strictly below \(27/4\).

zh: 我把 R0.49 固定的 \(c=4/5\) 放回完整乘法特征族 \(\omega_s=c^s\)。真实 \(s=162,j=81\) 活跃列成为正 Laurent 多项式 \[ A(r,c)=\sum_{i,q}b_{iq}r^ic^q,\qquad b_{iq}>0, \] 其荷支撑从 \(-1\) 到 \(157\)。固定半径时， \(A(r,e^t)\) 对 \(t=\log c\) 严格凸且两端趋于无穷； 固定 \(c\) 时，它对 \(r\) 严格递增。
en: I return the fixed value \(c=4/5\) from R0.49 to the complete multiplicative-character family \(\omega_s=c^s\). The true \(s=162,j=81\) active column becomes the positive Laurent polynomial \[ A(r,c)=\sum_{i,q}b_{iq}r^ic^q,\qquad b_{iq}>0, \] whose charge support runs from \(-1\) to \(157\). At fixed radius, \(A(r,e^t)\) is strictly convex in \(t=\log c\) and tends to infinity at both ends; at fixed \(c\), it is strictly increasing in \(r\).

zh: 我把 R0.51 的固定有理参数放回完整仿射权重族 \[ \omega_s(c,\lambda)=c^s(1+\lambda|s|), \qquad c>0,\quad\lambda\ge0. \] 令 \(\alpha=\lambda/(1+162\lambda)\)，活跃列与零荷列连同 约束交线上的驻定条件化为三个精确多项式方程。
en: I return the fixed rational parameters from R0.51 to the complete affine weight family \[ \omega_s(c,\lambda)=c^s(1+\lambda|s|), \qquad c>0,\quad\lambda\ge0. \] With \(\alpha=\lambda/(1+162\lambda)\), the active column, zero-charge column, and stationarity condition along their constraint intersection become three exact polynomial equations.

zh: 我把 R0.9 的第一条跨壳边增厚为四个三维球形频率包。 目标模态的输入配对重数满足 \(m_N/N^3\to(8\pi/3)\delta^3\)，正好达到稀疏估计留下的临界阈值。
en: I thickened the first inter-shell edge of R0.9 into four three-dimensional spherical frequency packets. The multiplicity of the input pairing for the target mode satisfies \(m_N/N^3\to(8\pi/3)\delta^3\), precisely reaching the critical threshold left by the sparse estimate.

zh: 我把 Rudin--Shapiro 热流的 \(L^\infty\) 上界直接放进三重 Duhamel 积分，并结合二次目标的严格下界，得到对所有 dyadic \(L,M\) 与全部 \(1\le m\le M\) 成立的估计 \[ |R_{L,M,m}|\le7.8343\left(\frac mM\right)^2\sqrt M. \] 它把无符号端点估计从 \(O(LM)\) 改进为 \(O(\sqrt M)\)。
en: I insert the Rudin--Shapiro \(L^\infty\) heat-flow bound directly into the triple Duhamel integral and combine it with the strict lower bound for the quadratic target. For every dyadic \(L,M\) and all \(1\le m\le M\), this gives \[ |R_{L,M,m}|\le7.8343\left(\frac mM\right)^2\sqrt M. \] It improves the sign-free endpoint estimate from \(O(LM)\) to \(O(\sqrt M)\).

zh: 我把乘法荷特征扩展为非乘法但次乘的权重 \[ \omega_s(c,\lambda)=c^s(1+\lambda|s|). \] 三角不等式给出 \(\omega_{a+b}\le\omega_a\omega_b\)，所以代数常数仍为一。 对正输入荷 \(s\ge2\)，列比精确压缩成 \[ \frac{\omega_{s+q}}{\omega_s} =c^q\left(1+\frac{\lambda q}{1+\lambda s}\right). \]
en: I extend the multiplicative charge character to the nonmultiplicative but submultiplicative weight \[ \omega_s(c,\lambda)=c^s(1+\lambda|s|). \] The triangle inequality gives \(\omega_{a+b}\le\omega_a\omega_b\), so the algebra constant remains one. For positive input charge \(s\ge2\), the column ratio compresses exactly to \[ \frac{\omega_{s+q}}{\omega_s} =c^q\left(1+\frac{\lambda q}{1+\lambda s}\right). \]

zh: 我把单三元组的 Waleffe 几何系数与 \(\dot H^{1/2}\) 权重合并， 并在归一化近对角域 \(1/2\le x\le1\)、\(1\le y\le1+x\) 上求出四个螺旋符号类的精确极值。
en: I combined the Waleffe geometric coefficient for single triads with the weight \(\dot H^{1/2}\) and found precise extrema for four helical symbol classes on the normalized near-diagonal domain \(1/2\le x\le1\), \(1\le y\le1+x\).

zh: 我把度数不超过 \(N\) 的中心多项式 \(p_N\) 与次数严格大于 \(N\) 的修正 \(h\) 分开。 R0.37 的混合分层估计因此满足 \(\min(i,j)=i\)，并给出新的全阶尾部界 \[ \|D\Phi(p_N)h\|_{\mathcal B_r}\le 3\left(M_N(r)+\frac{S_N(r)}{N+1}\right)\|h\|_{\mathcal B_r}. \] 这不是有限列范数外推，而是对全部严格高阶尾部成立。
en: I separate a center polynomial of degree at most \(N\), namely \(p_N\), from corrections of degree strictly greater than \(N\), namely \(h\). The mixed layer estimate from R0.37 therefore has \(\min(i,j)=i\) and gives the new all-order tail bound \[ \|D\Phi(p_N)h\|_{\mathcal B_r}\le 3\left(M_N(r)+\frac{S_N(r)}{N+1}\right)\|h\|_{\mathcal B_r}. \] This is not an extrapolation from finite column norms; it holds for every strict high-order tail.

zh: 我把负实轴候选移到 \(x=-R\)，定义 \(B_U(x)=\widehat U_1(-x)\)、\(B_V(x)=-\widehat V_1(-x)\)， 并检查 \(H_U=B_U'/B_U\)、\(H_V=B_V'/B_V\)。现有两个输运序列各 50 项系数都为正，但这只是一项有限事实。
en: I move the negative-real candidate to \(x=-R\), define \(B_U(x)=\widehat U_1(-x)\) and \(B_V(x)=-\widehat V_1(-x)\), and test \(H_U=B_U'/B_U\) and \(H_V=B_V'/B_V\). All 50 available coefficients of each transport series are positive, but this is only a finite fact.

zh: 我把工作拆成几步。每一步都写清要得到什么、怎样检查，以及什么时候先停下来。
en: I break down the work into steps. Each step clearly states what is to be obtained, how to check it, and when to stop prematurely.

zh: 我把荷 \(s\) 的权重取为乘法特征 \(\omega_s=c^s\)，并固定 \(c=4/5\)。荷的可加性给出精确 代数共轭：缩放 \(S_c[Z^mW^n]=c^{2n-m}Z^mW^n\) 与约化非线性映射交换。等价双圆盘半径为 \(\rho_Z=r/c\) 与 \(\rho_W=rc^2\)。
en: I take the weight of charge \(s\) to be the multiplicative character \(\omega_s=c^s\) and fix \(c=4/5\). Charge additivity gives an exact algebraic conjugacy: the scaling \(S_c[Z^mW^n]=c^{2n-m}Z^mW^n\) commutes with the reduced nonlinear map. The equivalent bidisk radii are \(\rho_Z=r/c\) and \(\rho_W=rc^2\).

zh: 我把荷权扩展为 \[ \omega_s=c^s(1+\lambda|s|)(1+\mu|s|), \] 并固定简单分数 \(c=396403/500000\)、 \(\lambda=\mu=153931/500000\)。两个仿射因子分别次乘， 因而乘积仍保持代数常数一。
en: I extend the charge weight to \[ \omega_s=c^s(1+\lambda|s|)(1+\mu|s|), \] and fix the simple fractions \(c=396403/500000\) and \(\lambda=\mu=153931/500000\). Each affine factor is submultiplicative, so their product still has algebra constant one.

zh: 我把近场 Calderón–Zygmund 项、过渡壳层、速度生成远场尾与精确环带通量放到同一临界尺度。若 \[ B_M=\sum_{m=2}^{M-1}2^{-5m}e_m +2^{-5M}\sum_{m\ge M}e_m,\qquad A=2^M, \] 则局部压力配对满足 \[ r^3|\mathcal P_r| \le C\min\{b_r,\sigma_r(N_r+B_M)\}. \]
en: I place the near Calderón–Zygmund term, transition shells, velocity-generated far tail, and exact annular flux on one critical scale. If \[ B_M=\sum_{m=2}^{M-1}2^{-5m}e_m +2^{-5M}\sum_{m\ge M}e_m,\qquad A=2^M, \] then the localized pressure pairing satisfies \[ r^3|\mathcal P_r| \le C\min\{b_r,\sigma_r(N_r+B_M)\}. \]

zh: 我把跨壳门和两个壳内翼门写成三个精确 Fourier–Leray 映射。 通过坐标镜像选择 \(b_n,d_n\) 的催化极化，三个前向目标都非零， \(P_n-Q_n\)、\(a_n-b_n\)、\(a_n-d_n\) 三个差频中心则同时为零。
en: I wrote the cross-shell door and two inner wing doors as three exact Fourier–Leray mappings. By coordinate mirroring, I selected the catalytic polarization of \(b_n,d_n\); all three forward targets are non-zero, while the three difference frequency centers of \(P_n-Q_n\), \(a_n-b_n\), and \(a_n-d_n\) are simultaneously zero.

zh: 我把每个带电边界系数唯一分成单位尖锐模态与单位纵向模态。 在 R0.22 标签对上，尖锐—尖锐、两个混合通道和纵向—纵向通道分别按 \(N^2,N,N,1\) 增长。
en: I decompose each charged boundary coefficient uniquely into a unit sharp mode and a unit longitudinal mode. On the R0.22 label pair, the sharp–sharp, two mixed, and longitudinal–longitudinal channels grow respectively as \(N^2,N,N,1\).

zh: 我把频率包离开原支撑的速度写成严格的一阶距离公式，并定义无量纲的逃逸/注入比。 R0.4 原剖面的这个比值在高频尺度稳定于约 58.24。
en: I wrote the speed at which the frequency packets leave their original support as a strict first-order distance formula and defined dimensionless escape/injection ratios. The ratio for R0.4's original cross-section stabilizes to approximately 58.24 on high-frequency scales.

zh: 我把四个实极化参数的全部一阶、二阶导数传播到完整第五阶树。 15 组聚合 Laurent 系列的负幂全部精确抵消；振幅方向二阶导数为 \(484.5103860596\ldots>0\)，而公共催化旋转方向的一阶导数为零、图坐标曲率为 \(-4.5685997502\ldots<0\)。
en: I propagated all first and second derivatives of four real polarized parameters to the complete fifth-order tree. All negative powers in fifteen groups of aggregated Laurent series are precisely canceled; the second derivative in the amplitude direction is \(484.5103860596\ldots>0\), while the first derivative in the common catalytic rotation direction is zero, with the curvature in the plot coordinates being \(-4.5685997502\ldots<0\).

zh: 我把完整第五阶树写成反对称坐标 \((p,q,x)\) 下的精确有理商。 三个驻点分子共有 3750 至 4025 项。 以精确有理 Jacobian 逆构造的 Krawczyk 像严格落在半径 \(10^{-30}\) 的盒内， 因而盒内存在且只有一个驻点。
en: I wrote the complete fifth-order tree as an exact rational quotient under the antisymmetric coordinates \((p,q,x)\). The three stationary points have a total of 3750 to 4025 terms in their numerators. The Krawczyk image, constructed with an exact rational Jacobian inverse, strictly falls within a box of radius \(10^{-30}\), thus ensuring the existence and uniqueness of one stationary point inside the box.

zh: 我把完整正和写成 \[ H_r(x)=\sum_{i,q}|a_{i,q}|r^i d_i\beta_q\frac{|ix-q|}{3}. \] 所有权重非负，所以 \(H_r\) 在 \([0,2]\) 上凸； 其全阶最大值严格等于 \(\max\{H_r(0),H_r(2)\}\)。 这覆盖每个 \(s\ge241\) 和允许的 \(j>80\)，不依赖有限折点或符号抵消。
en: I write the complete positive sum as \[ H_r(x)=\sum_{i,q}|a_{i,q}|r^i d_i\beta_q\frac{|ix-q|}{3}. \] All weights are nonnegative, so \(H_r\) is convex on \([0,2]\); its all-order maximum is exactly \(\max\{H_r(0),H_r(2)\}\). This covers every \(s\ge241\) and every allowed \(j>80\), without finite breakpoints or sign cancellation.

zh: 我把无界的 \((\lambda,\mu)\) 象限压缩为 \[ A=\alpha+\beta,\qquad B=\alpha\beta, \qquad 0\le A\le2h, \quad\max\{0,h(A-h)\}\le B\le A^2/4, \] 其中 \(\alpha=\lambda/(1+162\lambda)\)、 \(\beta=\mu/(1+162\mu)\)、\(h=1/162\)。 这个紧半代数域完整保留有限参数与所有边界退化。
en: I compress the unbounded \((\lambda,\mu)\) quadrant into \[ A=\alpha+\beta,\qquad B=\alpha\beta, \qquad 0\le A\le2h, \quad\max\{0,h(A-h)\}\le B\le A^2/4, \] where \(\alpha=\lambda/(1+162\lambda)\), \(\beta=\mu/(1+162\mu)\), and \(h=1/162\). This compact semialgebraic domain completely retains finite parameters and every boundary degeneration.

zh:
我把压力分成近场 Newton 部分与球内调和的远场部分。对 \(Q_R=
abla^2p_{\mathrm{far}}(0)\)，余项满足 \[ |
abla^2p_{\mathrm{far}}(x)-Q_R| \le Cr\int_{|y|\ge R} rac{|q(y)|}{|y|^4}\,dy, \] 因而每个远程壳获得一个 \(r/R\) 因子。但零质量、零偶极矩的精确四源见证仍给出 \(Q_R=3(2\pi R^3)^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,0)\)，与迹零应变的配对为 \(3/(\pi R^3)
e0\)。12 项形式检查全部通过。
en:
I split the pressure into a near-field Newtonian part and a far-field part harmonic on the ball. For \(Q_R=
abla^2p_{\mathrm{far}}(0)\), the remainder satisfies \[ |
abla^2p_{\mathrm{far}}(x)-Q_R| \le Cr\int_{|y|\ge R} rac{|q(y)|}{|y|^4}\,dy, \] so each remote shell gains an \(r/R\) factor. Yet an exact zero-mass, zero-dipole four-source witness gives \(Q_R=3(2\pi R^3)^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,0)\), whose pairing with trace-free strain is \(3/(\pi R^3)
e0\). All 12 formal checks passed.

zh: 我把已经完成的研究压成一棵路线树。中间是继续推进的主干，左右是保留下来的结果和已经停止的支路。每个节点默认只显示阶段判断；展开“笔记链接”后，可以直接打开这一段的原始记录。
en: I compress the completed research into a route tree. The continuing trunk runs through the middle, with retained results and stopped branches on the left and right. By default, each node shows only the stage assessment; expanding “note links” opens the original records for that segment directly.

zh: 我把正负催化叶分开计数，并允许两种催化模态具有任意复振幅。 70 个复能量单项式只依赖一个相对相位，并可精确改写为三个不变量 \(x=|\beta+\delta|^2\)、\(y=|\beta-\delta|^2\) 和 \(0\le h\le xy\) 上的 50 项有理多项式。
en: I separate the positive and negative catalytic leaves for counting, allowing both catalytic modes to have arbitrary complex amplitudes. 70 single-valued complex energy monomials depend only on one relative phase and can be precisely rewritten as a 50-term rational polynomial on three invariants \(x=|\beta+\delta|^2\), \(y=|\beta-\delta|^2\), and \(0\le h\le xy\).

zh: 我把中心六模态写成六个复振幅，得到临界传递与法向泄漏的完整闭式公式。 一个显式强制性不等式证明：固定临界范数时，非零临界传递必然产生正泄漏。
en: I write the central six-mode as six complex amplitudes to obtain a complete closed-form formula for critical transfer and normal leakage. An explicit coercive inequality proves that when fixing the critical norm, non-zero critical transfer necessarily produces positive leakage.

zh: 我保留中心单项式 \((i,q)\) 与尾部单项式 \((j,s)\) 的荷结构。 对非零输出荷，线性化系数精确化为 \[ \gamma_{i,q;j,s}=\frac{(is-qj)(s-q)}{3(s+q)(i+j-1)}, \] 输出荷为零时则使用消除表面奇性的另一有理式。由此不再丢失不同荷通道中的精确抵消。
en: I retain the charge structure of center monomials \((i,q)\) and tail monomials \((j,s)\). For nonzero output charge, the linearized coefficient is exactly \[ \gamma_{i,q;j,s}=\frac{(is-qj)(s-q)}{3(s+q)(i+j-1)}, \] while zero output charge uses another rational expression that removes the apparent singularity. Exact cancellation between charge channels is therefore preserved.

zh: 我从精确应变方程推导了最大应变特征值预算，并构造两族光滑周期无散速度场。它们在原点具有共同的局部数据 \[ S(0)=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,0),\qquad \omega(0)=0, \] 但压力响应严格为 \[ H_{11}^{-}(0)=-1-\frac{54}{85}t^2, \qquad H_{11}^{+}(0)=-1+\frac{54}{85}t^2. \]
en: I derived the principal-strain-eigenvalue budget from the exact strain equation and constructed two families of smooth periodic divergence-free velocity fields. At the origin they share the local data \[ S(0)=\operatorname{diag}(1,-1,0),\qquad \omega(0)=0, \] but their pressure responses are exactly \[ H_{11}^{-}(0)=-1-\frac{54}{85}t^2, \qquad H_{11}^{+}(0)=-1+\frac{54}{85}t^2. \]

zh: 我从旧壳双泵和新壳双催化的八个有符号模态出发，不删除二次项生成的外部频率， 递推普通幂级数到第五阶。R0.11 极化的首阶非线性泄漏/目标比趋于 \(14\varepsilon^2+2\varepsilon^4\)。
en: I start from eight signed modes of old-shell double pumps and new-shell double catalysis, not removing secondary terms generated external frequencies, and recursively generate ordinary power series up to the fifth order. The first-order nonlinear leakage/target ratio for R0.11 polarization tends to \(14\varepsilon^2+2\varepsilon^4\).

zh: 我从一个非零近对角三元组构造连续频谱剖面，再取 \(\widehat u_N(k)=N^{-3/2}a(k/N)\)。所得周期场真实、无散，活跃模态数按 \(N^3\) 增长。
en: I construct a continuous spectral profile from a non-zero near-diagonal triad and take \(\widehat u_N(k)=N^{-3/2}a(k/N)\). The resulting periodic field is real and divergence-free, with the number of active modes growing according to \(N^3\).

zh: 我改用 R0.29 的正则分解 \[ U=Z e^{\phi-a/2},\qquad V=W e^{\phi+a/2}, \] 其中 \(\mathcal L\phi-\{a,\phi\}=\tfrac12(X-Y)a\)。 对伸缩算子 \(S_a=\mathcal L^{-1}\{a,\cdot\}\)，输出次数除子与次数加权范数精确抵消，单项式列因子只剩 \(|i(s/j)-q|/3\)。
en: I use the R0.29 canonical factorization \[ U=Z e^{\phi-a/2},\qquad V=W e^{\phi+a/2}, \] where \(\mathcal L\phi-\{a,\phi\}=\tfrac12(X-Y)a\). For the stretch operator \(S_a=\mathcal L^{-1}\{a,\cdot\}\), the output-degree divisor cancels exactly against the degree-weighted norm, leaving the monomial column factor \(|i(s/j)-q|/3\).

zh: 我构造了一对十模态光滑周期涡量场。两者具有完全相同的点态框架协方差， 主投影处处为 \(P_1=e_3\otimes e_3\)，并满足 \[ \nabla P_1=0,\qquad [T_\alpha,I-P_1]=0, \] 以及绝对、顶特征值归一化和迹归一化的强谱隙。它们的协方差功却分别为 \[ \pm{3\sqrt2\over40}\Lambda^3. \] 因此，投影相干、谱隙和标量框架交换子本身不能决定这个三次功的符号或迫使其消失。
en: I constructed a pair of smooth periodic ten-mode vorticity fields. They have exactly the same pointwise frame covariance, their principal projector is \(P_1=e_3\otimes e_3\) everywhere, and they satisfy \[ \nabla P_1=0,\qquad [T_\alpha,I-P_1]=0, \] together with strong absolute, top-eigenvalue-normalized, and trace-normalized spectral gaps. Yet their covariance work values are respectively \[ \pm{3\sqrt2\over40}\Lambda^3. \] Therefore, projector coherence, the spectral gap, and the scalar-frame commutator alone cannot determine the sign of this cubic work or force it to vanish.

zh: 我构造了一个定量的光滑径向截断 \(q\)，其过渡能量满足 \[ E=\int_1^2 s q'(s)^2\,ds\le\frac{50}{21}<\frac52. \] 对 \(R=2^m\) 的紧支撑仿射场族，固定单位核心的全部正生产仍由跨边界点对承载。两条极限环带系数精确为 \[ I_-=\frac52+E,\qquad I_+=\frac52-E, \] 所以外环带至少保留 \(1/42\) 的严格份额。紧支撑几何进一步证明：充分大二进半径上只有 \(j=m-1,m\) 两项非零，且两项都正，因而 \(\Gamma_{\rm core}(R)=1\) 恰好成立。
en: I construct a quantitative smooth radial cutoff \(q\) whose transition energy satisfies \[ E=\int_1^2 s q'(s)^2\,ds\le\frac{50}{21}<\frac52. \] For the compactly supported affine family with \(R=2^m\), all positive production in the fixed unit core is still carried by cross-boundary pairs. The two limiting annular coefficients are exactly \[ I_-=\frac52+E,\qquad I_+=\frac52-E, \] so the outer annulus retains a strict share of at least \(1/42\). Compact-support geometry further proves that, at sufficiently large dyadic radii, only \(j=m-1,m\) are nonzero and both are positive; hence \(\Gamma_{\rm core}(R)=1\) exactly.

zh: 我构造了一个由六个 Fourier 模态组成的实、光滑、零均值无散场。 三个正频率 \(k=(1,0,0)\)、\(p=(0,1,0)\)、\(q=(-1,-1,0)\) 闭合成三角形，平方模长为 \(1,1,2\)，因此全部位于壳 \(1\le|r|<2\)。17 项形式检查全部通过。
en: I constructed a real, smooth, mean-zero, divergence-free field from six Fourier modes. The three positive frequencies \(k=(1,0,0)\), \(p=(0,1,0)\), and \(q=(-1,-1,0)\) close into a triad and have squared lengths \(1,1,2\), so all lie in the shell \(1\le|r|<2\). All 17 formal checks passed.

zh: 我归一化两个尖锐输运数组为 \(U=-12u\)、\(V=-3v\)，并用 Jacobi 恒等式和形式次数唯一性证明 \(\{U,V\}=UV\)。进一步有 \(U/V=(Z/W)e^{-a}\)，所以 \((U,V)\) 是近恒等的对数辛坐标，而不是两组独立的无限数组。
en: I normalize the two sharp transport arrays as \(U=-12u\) and \(V=-3v\), then use the Jacobi identity and uniqueness by formal degree to prove \(\{U,V\}=UV\). Moreover, \(U/V=(Z/W)e^{-a}\), so \((U,V)\) is a near-identity pair of log-symplectic coordinates rather than two independent infinite arrays.

zh: 我还在完整二维根盒上构造逐系数荷上下包络。238 个其他固定正荷、 一个同荷非活跃端点、三个特殊荷扇区和无穷大荷扇区共同组成 243 个 竞争对象，全部留下严格正间隙。最近者仍为 \(s=164\)，间隙约 \(1.4580280494\times10^{-4}\)。
en: I also construct coefficientwise charge envelopes over the full two-dimensional root box. The 243 competitors comprise 238 other fixed positive charges, one inactive endpoint at the same charge, three special-charge sectors, and the infinite large-charge sector; every one leaves a strictly positive gap. The nearest remains \(s=164\), with a gap of about \(1.4580280494\times10^{-4}\).

zh: 我恢复了周期 Biot–Savart 表示中的有符号涡量拉伸核。固定一个不接触原点的环带 \(A\)，令 \[ K_{x,t}(z)= \frac{D(\widehat z,\xi(x+z,t),\xi(x,t))}{|z|^3}. \] 对所有非负单位质量权重，严格恒等式为 \[ \sup_{\substack{g\ge0\\ \int_Ag=1}} \left|\int_AK_{x,t}g\right| =\|K_{x,t}\|_{L^\infty(A)}. \]
en: I recovered the signed vorticity-stretching kernel in the periodic Biot-Savart representation. Fix an annulus \(A\) away from the origin and set \[ K_{x,t}(z)= \frac{D(\widehat z,\xi(x+z,t),\xi(x,t))}{|z|^3}. \] For all nonnegative unit-mass weights, the exact identity is \[ \sup_{\substack{g\ge0\\ \int_Ag=1}} \left|\int_AK_{x,t}g\right| =\|K_{x,t}\|_{L^\infty(A)}. \]

zh: 我回到完整 Fourier–Leray 算子，先确认临界障碍，再把一个不变剪切族的高阶目标逐项算清。
en: I returned to the full Fourier–Leray operator, first confirmed the critical obstruction, and then computed the higher-order targets of one invariant shear family term by term.

zh: 我记录对三维不可压缩 Navier–Stokes 全局正则性问题的梳理、计算和未解决步骤。
en: I record my reading, calculations, and unresolved steps on the global regularity problem for the three-dimensional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations.

zh: 我检查 \[C(x)=P_d(x)+\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{d\mu(t)}{1-xt},\qquad \mu\ge0,\] 其中 \(C\) 依次取 \(B_U,B_V,H_U,H_V\)，而 \(P_d\) 的实系数完全任意。 当尾起点 \(s>d\) 时，多项式不能改变矩阵 \((c_{s+i_\alpha+i_\beta})\)。非负测度却要求该矩阵半正定。
en: I test \[C(x)=P_d(x)+\int_{[0,\infty)}\frac{d\mu(t)}{1-xt},\qquad \mu\ge0,\] where \(C\) runs through \(B_U,B_V,H_U,H_V\) and the real coefficients of \(P_d\) are completely arbitrary. When the tail start satisfies \(s>d\), the polynomial cannot change the matrix \((c_{s+i_\alpha+i_\beta})\), while a nonnegative measure requires that matrix to be positive semidefinite.

zh:
我精确局部化了压力—应变正交与 Betchov 相消。对任意光滑权重，压力配对成为 \[ \int\phi S:
abla^2p =\int(\Delta p)u\cdot
abla\phi +\int u_i(\partial_jp)(\partial_{ij}\phi), \] 三次相消则成为 \[ \int\phi\operatorname{tr}(A^3) =\int\left( rac12qu-A^2uight)\cdot
abla\phi. \]
en:
I exactly localized pressure-strain orthogonality and Betchov cancellation. For any smooth weight, the pressure pairing becomes \[ \int\phi S:
abla^2p =\int(\Delta p)u\cdot
abla\phi +\int u_i(\partial_jp)(\partial_{ij}\phi), \] while the cubic cancellation becomes \[ \int\phi\operatorname{tr}(A^3) =\int\left( rac12qu-A^2uight)\cdot
abla\phi. \]

zh: 我利用 \(m_2=-L\) 的极端面选择律，把十六阶目标从三维支持立方体严格约化为闭合二维递推。 任何面外树历史都不能回到最小叶目标；受限递推逐项复现了 R0.23 的三个完整 \(N=2\) 二次域系数。
en: I use the extreme-face selection rule \(m_2=-L\) to reduce the order-16 target exactly from the three-dimensional support cube to a closed two-dimensional recurrence. No off-face tree history can return to a minimal-leaf target; the restricted recurrence reproduces the three full R0.23 quadratic-field coefficients at \(N=2\) component by component.

zh: 我利用负边缘上全部偏移共线的几何，把每个四分量系数唯一写成纵向标量 \(\alpha\) 与尖锐标量 \(s\)。 两个标量递推进一步合成一个带零电荷投影的非线性生成方程，以及一个由它驱动的线性输运方程。
en: I use the collinearity of every offset on the negative edge to write each four-component coefficient uniquely in terms of a longitudinal scalar \(\alpha\) and a sharp scalar \(s\). The two scalar recurrences combine into a nonlinear generating equation with a zero-charge projection and a linear transport equation driven by it.

zh: 我令 \(\rho_*=4/81\)、\(\delta=\rho_*/7\)，选择中心 \(c=(\delta,-\delta)\)、内半径 \(\mathsf r=\delta\) 和外半径 \(\mathsf R=5\delta\)。 外局部圆盘离原点最远为 \(6\rho_*/7\)，内圆盘的仿射荷轨道最远为 \(3\rho_*/7\)， 因而两项包含都有精确正间隙。
en: I set \(\rho_*=4/81\) and \(\delta=\rho_*/7\), choosing center \(c=(\delta,-\delta)\), inner radius \(\mathsf r=\delta\), and outer radius \(\mathsf R=5\delta\). The outer local disc reaches at most \(6\rho_*/7\) from the origin, while the affine charge orbit of the inner disc reaches at most \(3\rho_*/7\); both inclusions therefore have exact positive margins.

zh: 我令 \(t=1/j\)，把完整固定荷列写成精确有理函数 \(F_r(t)\)。 中心荷 \(q=-1\) 的项消失，\(q=0\) 与 \(q\ge2\) 的项递增， 只有 \(q=1\) 的项递减。度一 \(q=2\) 种子单独给出 \(r(3+2t)\ge3r\) 的正导数。
en: I set \(t=1/j\) and write the complete fixed-charge column as the exact rational function \(F_r(t)\). Terms with center charge \(q=-1\) vanish, terms with \(q=0\) or \(q\ge2\) increase, and only terms with \(q=1\) decrease. The degree-one \(q=2\) seed alone supplies the positive derivative \(r(3+2t)\ge3r\).

zh: 我另做了一页系统综述，把经典理论、五条文献主干、候选爆破排除树、2019—2026 年进展和本站 R0.69P–R0.71B 路线放在同一张图中。
en: I also prepared a separate systematic review that places the classical theory, five major literature threads, the candidate demolition tree, developments from 2019—2026, and this site's R0.69P–R0.71B route in a single map.

en: I am currently considering directions

zh: 我目前只讨论 Clay 正式表述中的原始方程。修正模型、数值现象和条件结果会单独标明，不把它们写成原问题的解答。
en: I am currently only discussing the original equations in the Clay formal problem. Corrected models, numerical phenomena, and conditional results will be separately marked and not written as solutions to the original problem.

zh:
我随后按真实 Fourier 输出定义 \[ w_k=2\operatorname{Re}(\overline{\widehat S(k)}:\widehat Q(k)), \qquad a_+= rac1{\|\omega\|_2^2} \sum_k rac{(w_k^+)^2}{4|k|^2|\widehat S(k)|_F^2}. \] 它区分 R0.71A 的同协方差反号对，并给出精确估计 \[ (\mathfrak P_Q)_+ \le rac
u4\|
abla\omega\|_2^2 +
u^{-1}a_+\|\omega\|_2^2. \]
en:
I then defined, from the actual Fourier output, \[ w_k=2\operatorname{Re}(\overline{\widehat S(k)}:\widehat Q(k)), \qquad a_+= rac1{\|\omega\|_2^2} \sum_k rac{(w_k^+)^2}{4|k|^2|\widehat S(k)|_F^2}. \] It distinguishes the equal-covariance opposite-sign pair from R0.71A and gives the exact estimate \[ (\mathfrak P_Q)_+ \le rac
u4\|
abla\omega\|_2^2 +
u^{-1}a_+\|\omega\|_2^2. \]

zh: 我完成了 R0.21 留下的解析权卷积估计。对半径差 \(\eta=\rho-\rho'\)， 全空间双线性上界为 \(1/(e\eta)+24/(e^2\eta^2)\)。这个二阶项不是粗估计。
en: I complete the convolution estimate for R0.21 left behind by analytic weights. For a radius difference \(\eta=\rho-\rho'\), the full-space bilinear upper bound is \(1/(e\eta)+24/(e^2\eta^2)\). This second-order term is not a crude estimate.

zh: 我为每个固定正荷 \(s\) 保留其最低允许次数 \(J_s\)，把精确的 \(d_i(J_s)=(i+J_s)/(i+J_s-1)\) 留在完整正和中。 余下部分关于共同斜率 \(x=s/j\) 凸，所以每个固定荷的全部 \(j\ge J_s\) 只需两个端点。有限枚举的 239 项因此是 239 个 全次数定理，不是尾次数网格。
en: For each fixed positive charge \(s\), I retain its minimum admissible degree \(J_s\) and keep the exact factor \(d_i(J_s)=(i+J_s)/(i+J_s-1)\) inside the complete positive sum. The remainder is convex in the common slope \(x=s/j\), so all \(j\ge J_s\) for one fixed charge require only two endpoints. The finite enumeration of 239 items is therefore 239 all-degree theorems, not a tail-degree grid.

zh: 我先把 R0.4 初值按临界幅度归一化。黏性耗散与三线性注入都在 \(\tau=N^2t\) 上出现。对热流剖面可以证明一个显式的同号区间； \(N=60\) 到 \(120\) 的离散半幅下界稳定在 \(\tau\approx0.00798\)。
en: I first normalize the initial data of R0.4 to critical amplitudes. Viscous dissipation and trilinear injection appear on \(\tau=N^2t\). For thermal flux profiles, one can prove an explicit same-sign interval; the discrete half-amplitude lower bound for \(N=60\) to \(120\) is stably at \(\tau\approx0.00798\).

zh: 我先固定方程、定义域、初值和解的概念。改变这些条件后得到的结果，只能作为相关问题来讨论。
en: I first fix the equation, domain, initial data, and concept of solutions. Results obtained by changing these conditions can only be discussed as related problems.

zh: 我先检验 Hardy–BMO：div–curl 确实给出 \(\|q_v\|_{\mathcal H^1}\lesssim\|\nabla v\|_2^2\)， 但其对偶线满足 \(sp'=3\)，高于能量耗散点 \(W^{1,2}\)；Hilbert 对偶需要 \(3/2\) 阶导数。
en: I first test Hardy–BMO: div–curl indeed gives \(\|q_v\|_{\mathcal H^1}\lesssim\|\nabla v\|_2^2\), but its dual line satisfies \(sp'=3\), above the energy-dissipation point \(W^{1,2}\); Hilbert duality requires \(3/2\) derivatives.

zh: 我先研究 \(\mathbb T^3\) 上的无外力正面命题，并固定定义、Fourier 约定和解类。
en: I first study the positive statement without external forces on \(\mathbb T^3\), fixing definitions, Fourier conventions, and solution classes.

zh: 我先研究的版本：Clay 命题 B
en: I first study version: Clay problem B

zh: 我先用基础推导和小算例检查公式，再逐步缩小还没有处理的频率区域。
en: I first check formulas with basic derivations and small examples before gradually narrowing down the unprocessed frequency regions.

zh: 我先在全空间有符号 Biot–Savart 核中消去涡量方向分母，再交换两个空间点，严格得到 \[ \mathcal V(u)=\frac3{8\pi}\iint \frac{(e\cdot\delta\omega) (e\cdot(\omega(x)\times\delta\omega))}{|x-y|^3}\,dy\,dx. \] 分子含两个涡量增量，核绝对可积。插入平滑径向分割后，所有物理环带的有符号和精确重构总拉伸；有限窗口只留下两条显式近、远尾。12 项源锁定结构检查全部通过。
en: I first eliminate the vorticity-direction denominator from the full-space signed Biot-Savart kernel and then exchange the two spatial points, rigorously obtaining \[ \mathcal V(u)=\frac3{8\pi}\iint \frac{(e\cdot\delta\omega) (e\cdot(\omega(x)\times\delta\omega))}{|x-y|^3}\,dy\,dx. \] The numerator contains two vorticity increments and the kernel is absolutely integrable. After insertion of a smooth radial partition, the signed sum over all physical annuli reconstructs total stretching exactly, while a finite window leaves only two explicit near and far tails. All 12 source-locked structural checks passed.

zh: 我修正了对向上电荷耦合的增长判断：\(k f_{k,q+1}\) 会破坏固定有限截断，但求解递推后的实际系数是 \(k/(3k-q-1)\le1\)，所以它不妨碍无限带权估计。
en: I corrected the growth interpretation of the upward charge coupling: \(k f_{k,q+1}\) defeats a fixed finite truncation, but the actual coefficient after solving the recurrence is \(k/(3k-q-1)\le1\), so it does not prevent an infinite weighted estimate.

zh: 我用 \(R=Z^2W\)、\(\Xi=Z^{-1}\) 定义固定荷级数 \(F_q(R)=[\Xi^q]F(R,\Xi)\)。\(R^k\Xi^q\) 的总次数是 \(3k-q\)， 所以 R0.31 的全阶主控立即给出每个固定荷输运级数的严格解析圆盘 \[|R|<(4/81)^3=64/531441.\]
en: Using \(R=Z^2W\) and \(\Xi=Z^{-1}\), I define the fixed-charge series \(F_q(R)=[\Xi^q]F(R,\Xi)\). The total degree of \(R^k\Xi^q\) is \(3k-q\), so the R0.31 all-order majorant immediately gives the strict analytic disc \[|R|<(4/81)^3=64/531441.\] for every fixed-charge transport series.

zh: 我用叶计数整数方程进一步缩小了 R0.25 的边界递推。 \(b_N\) 是只含 \(P_-,C_+\) 的精确两生成元边缘系数；\(a_N\) 则恰好含一个边缘外叶，是 \(P_+,C_-\) 边缘的两个一阶变分之和。
en: I use the integer leaf-count equations to reduce the R0.25 boundary recurrence further. \(b_N\) is an exact two-generator edge coefficient containing only \(P_-,C_+\), while \(a_N\) has exactly one off-edge leaf and is the sum of two first variations of the \(P_+,C_-\) edge.

zh: 我用锥形变量消去共同转动二阶 jet 中的归一化平方根， 把六个导数指标传播到完整第五阶 Laurent 树。 聚合后共有 334 个被某个 jet 激活的频率，所有负 Laurent 幂逐项精确消失。
en: I use conical variables to eliminate the normalized square root in common rotational second-order jets, propagating six derivative indices to a complete fifth-order Laurent tree. After aggregation, there are 334 frequencies activated by some jet, with all negative Laurent powers vanishing precisely term-by-term.

zh: 我在 \(\mathbb R^3\) 或 \(\mathbb T^3\) 上使用 \(\mathcal X^\sigma\) Fourier--Lebesgue 量。Navier--Stokes 缩放给出 \[ \|u_\lambda\|_{\mathcal X^\sigma} =\lambda^{\sigma+1}\|u\|_{\mathcal X^\sigma}, \] 因而 \(L_t^\infty\mathcal X^{-1}\) 与 \(L_t^1\mathcal X^1\) 同时临界。
en: On \(\mathbb R^3\) or \(\mathbb T^3\), I use the \(\mathcal X^\sigma\) Fourier--Lebesgue quantity. Navier--Stokes scaling gives \[ \|u_\lambda\|_{\mathcal X^\sigma} =\lambda^{\sigma+1}\|u\|_{\mathcal X^\sigma}, \] so \(L_t^\infty\mathcal X^{-1}\) and \(L_t^1\mathcal X^1\) are both critical.

zh: 我在 R0.2 中整理了 dyadic 相互作用。对尺度相隔 \(M\) 壳的部分， low–high / high–low 获得 \(2^{-2M}\)，high–high→low 获得 \(2^{-3M}\)； 目前还没有小因子的区域是有限宽的近对角带。
en: In R0.2, I organize dyadic interactions. For parts of the shells separated by \(M\) in scale, low–high / high–low obtain \(2^{-2M}\), and high–high→low obtains \(2^{-3M}\); currently, there are no small factor regions that are finite-width near-diagonal bands.

zh: 我在主动支持锥 \(q=2k-n\ge-1\) 上引入总次数加权范数 \[\|f\|_{\mathcal B_r}=\sum_{n,k\ge0}(n+k)|f_{n,k}|r^{n+k}.\] 荷对称化与 \((i+j)\min(i,j)\le2ij\) 给出同半径全阶界 \[\|\Phi(f)\|_{\mathcal B_r}\le3\|f\|_{\mathcal B_r}^2,\qquad \|D\Phi(f)h\|_{\mathcal B_r}\le6\|f\|_{\mathcal B_r}\|h\|_{\mathcal B_r}.\]
en: On the active support cone \(q=2k-n\ge-1\), I introduce the total-degree weighted norm \[\|f\|_{\mathcal B_r}=\sum_{n,k\ge0}(n+k)|f_{n,k}|r^{n+k}.\] Charge symmetrization and \((i+j)\min(i,j)\le2ij\) give the all-order same-radius bound \[\|\Phi(f)\|_{\mathcal B_r}\le3\|f\|_{\mathcal B_r}^2,\qquad \|D\Phi(f)h\|_{\mathcal B_r}\le6\|f\|_{\mathcal B_r}\|h\|_{\mathcal B_r}.\]

zh: 我暂时从全局正则方向入手，但不预设答案。每个候选估计都会先检查缩放、Fourier 三波和已知反例模型。
en: I temporarily start from the global regularity direction but do not presuppose an answer. Each candidate estimate will first check scaling, Fourier three-wave, and known counterexample models.

zh: 我证明连通三波网络若要张成三维，至少需要五个无符号波数，并构造了两个只共享一个波数的整数频率蝶形。 在一个四参数极化中，临界传递与总涡量拉伸满足精确关系 \(\mathfrak S=-(\sqrt2+1)\mathfrak T\)，而外部非线性平方范数严格为正。
en: I prove that a connected triad network needs at least five unsigned wavenumbers to span three dimensions, and I construct two integer-frequency butterflies that share only one wavenumber. In a four-parameter polarization, the critical transfer and total vorticity stretching satisfy the exact relation \(\mathfrak S=-(\sqrt2+1)\mathfrak T\), while the squared norm of the external nonlinearity is strictly positive.

zh: 我重新使用领先压力项中已经可吸收的二阶导数量。紧支撑无散场满足 \[ \sigma_v^2\le C\mu_v\mathcal D_v^{1/2}, \] 两次 Young 不等式于是给出 \[ \mu_v^{1/2}\sigma_v^{3/2}\mathcal D_v^{1/2} \le\varepsilon\mathcal D_v +C\varepsilon^{-3}\mu_v^4\sigma_v^2. \] 时间余项因此回到二次涡量。取等优化证明 \(\mu^4\varepsilon^{-3}\) 是这个代数机制内的尖锐代价；18 项形式检查全部通过。
en: I reuse the second-derivative quantity already available for absorption in the leading pressure term. A compactly supported solenoidal field satisfies \[ \sigma_v^2\le C\mu_v\mathcal D_v^{1/2}, \] so two Young inequalities give \[ \mu_v^{1/2}\sigma_v^{3/2}\mathcal D_v^{1/2} \le\varepsilon\mathcal D_v +C\varepsilon^{-3}\mu_v^4\sigma_v^2. \] The time remainder therefore returns to quadratic enstrophy. Optimization at equality proves that \(\mu^4\varepsilon^{-3}\) is the sharp cost within this algebraic mechanism; all 18 formal checks passed.

zh: 我作变量代换 \(Z=-6z,\ W=3tw\)，把负边缘系列写成 \(A=\sqrt2\,a\) 与 \(S=\sqrt2(pu+qv)\)。 三个新数组 \(a,u,v\) 具有全阶有理数递推；零电荷投影被原样保留，参数 \(x\) 与根式生成元 \(t\) 从尖锐比中完全消失。
en: I make the change of variables \(Z=-6z,\ W=3tw\), writing the negative-edge series as \(A=\sqrt2\,a\) and \(S=\sqrt2(pu+qv)\). The three new arrays \(a,u,v\) satisfy an all-order rational recurrence; the zero-charge projection is preserved exactly, while \(x\) and the radical generator \(t\) disappear completely from the sharp ratio.

zh: 无根号递推与根盒上的有限比值分离
en: Radical-free recurrence and finite ratio separation on the root box

zh: 无根号化是全阶恒等式，符号与比值分离是有限精确定理。 尚未证明这些不等式对所有充分大的 \(N\) 延续，因此还不能把半径代理称为主导奇点。
en: Removing the radicals is an all-order identity; the sign and ratio separation is a finite exact theorem. These inequalities have not been proved for all sufficiently large \(N\), so the radius proxies cannot yet be identified with dominant singularities.

zh: 无外力
en: No external force

zh: 无外力 Leray–Hopf 非唯一性被一篇计算机辅助预印本主张实现；需要同行评议、代码复核与独立再验证。
en: No external force Leray–Hopf non-uniqueness is claimed to be realized by a computer-assisted preprint; it requires peer review, code verification, and independent revalidation.

zh: 无限电荷主级数与认证优化
en: Infinite-charge majorant series and certified optimization

zh: 无限分离统一返回基线是严格定理；有限分离比值、负号标准误和根障碍是随机化证据，不是同时置信区间或严格符号证明。它精确关闭继续扩大尺度比的路线，并把下一步缩成四个量的区间认证，但没有证明正则性或解决千禧年问题。
en: Uniform return to the baseline under infinite separation is a rigorous theorem. The finite-separation ratio, standard errors for negative signs, and root obstruction are randomized evidence, not simultaneous confidence intervals or rigorous sign proofs. The result precisely closes the route of increasing the scale ratio and reduces the next step to interval certification of four quantities, but it does not prove regularity or solve the Millennium problem.

zh: 五个无符号波数达到连通非共面三波网络的最小规模，并产生显式正涡量拉伸。
en: five unsigned wavenumbers reach the minimum scale to form a connected noncoplanar triad network, and produce an explicit positive vorticity stretching.

zh: 五载频约束只留下 \(A,B,C,D\) 四个自由坐标。令 \(W\) 为 320 维质量矩阵，\(E_j\) 为四个平移矩阵，则质量和四个一次矩 精确满足 \[ m'=Wm,\qquad \ell'_j=\frac1{16}(W\ell_j+E_jm). \] 这是 1600 维块三角系统。
en: The five-carrier constraint leaves only the four free coordinates \(A,B,C,D\). Let \(W\) be the 320-dimensional mass matrix and \(E_j\) the four shift matrices. The mass and four first moments satisfy exactly \[ m'=Wm,\qquad \ell'_j=\frac1{16}(W\ell_j+E_jm). \] This is a 1600-dimensional block-triangular system.

zh: 五至七阶带粘性目标系数已经精确认证；薄锥频率的大参数抵消已完成模式级证明。无限 Taylor 尾仍未闭合。
en: Fifth to seventh order viscous target coefficients have been precisely certified; the parameter for narrow cone frequencies has been canceled at mode level. The infinite Taylor tail is still not closed.

zh: 下界只覆盖固定极化、等幅同相实振幅和纯非线性六次齐次项。 不等幅、复相位、热项、Taylor 余项、稠密包与逐壳 PDE 迭代都没有包含。
en: The lower bound only covers fixed polarization, equal amplitude in phase real amplitudes, and pure nonlinear homogeneous sextic terms. Unequal amplitudes, complex phases, heat terms, Taylor remainder terms, dense packets, and shell-by-shell PDE iterations are not included.

zh: 先测试最小多尺度协方差 frame 的一致强制性，再决定是否进入仿射相对估计。代数门槛通过以前，不启动大规模 DNS。
en: First test uniform coercivity of the minimal multiscale covariance frame, then decide whether to proceed to affine-relative estimates. No large-scale DNS will be launched before the algebraic gate is passed.

zh: 先明确候选无限阶系数族对临界范数或奇性判据的严格蕴含，再研究阶数递推、生成函数、不变锥和统一尾界。
en: First establish the rigorous implication of the candidate infinite coefficient family for a critical norm or singularity criterion, then study an order recurrence, generating function, invariant cone, and uniform tail bound.

zh: 先停条件
en: Stopping condition

zh: 先研究的情形
en: Initial study case

zh: 先证明全频下框架与变方向交换子的条件桥，再检查这些假设是否由 Navier–Stokes 协方差账本传播。
en: I will first prove the conditional bridge based on an all-frequency lower frame and the variable-direction commutator, then test whether its hypotheses are propagated by the Navier–Stokes covariance ledger.

zh: 显式见证是二维流函数嵌入，因此本身全局光滑。结果只排除局部逐点闭合，不排除压力的全局正交、局部化预算或跨尺度机制，也不给出正则性结论。
en: The explicit witnesses are two-dimensional stream-function embeddings and are therefore globally smooth. The result rules out only local pointwise closure; it does not exclude global pressure orthogonality, localized budgets, or cross-scale mechanisms, and it gives no regularity conclusion.

zh: 显式下界很不锋利，Hessian 仍是浮点审计，稠密包也没有随 \(N\) 和锥宽统一的 PDE 估计。
en: The explicit lower bound is not sharp, the Hessian remains a floating-point audit, and dense packets are not included with \(N\) and PDE estimates that unify cone width.

zh: 现有的全局控制量位于超临界尺度，而已知正则性判据需要临界或更强的控制。下面是我反复遇到的四个问题。
en: The existing global control quantities are at supercritical scales, while known regularity criteria require critical or stronger controls. Below are four issues I repeatedly encounter.

zh: 相对 R0.49 的上根端点，阈值半径的严格增益因子大于 \(1.0000030613272706956\)，即约 3.061 ppm；固定荷变量 \(R=Z^2W\) 的 \(r^3\) 圆盘增益因子大于 \(1.0000091840099272895\)。这说明 \(c=4/5\) 虽非精确最优， 但已经非常接近整个乘法族的最优值。
en: Relative to the upper root endpoint of R0.49, the strict threshold-radius gain factor exceeds \(1.0000030613272706956\), or about 3.061 ppm; in the fixed-charge variable \(R=Z^2W\), the \(r^3\) disk gain factor exceeds \(1.0000091840099272895\). Thus \(c=4/5\) is not exactly optimal, but it is already extremely close to the optimum of the complete multiplicative family.

zh: 相对 R0.50 的全局最优乘法阈值，半径增益因子严格大于 \(1.0000121743210599539\)，约 12.174 ppm；固定荷变量 \(R=Z^2W\) 的 \(r^3\) 圆盘增益因子大于 \(1.0000365234078239459\)。这说明更宽的次乘权重确有作用， 同时也把下一瓶颈明确定位到零荷约束。
en: Relative to the globally optimal R0.50 multiplicative threshold, the radius gain factor is strictly greater than \(1.0000121743210599539\), or about 12.174 ppm. For the fixed-charge variable \(R=Z^2W\), the \(r^3\) disk gain factor is greater than \(1.0000365234078239459\). This shows that the broader submultiplicative weight is effective and identifies the zero-charge constraint as the next bottleneck.

zh: 相对 R0.51 的固定有理权重，新增相对半径只有约 \(6.732\times10^{-12}\)。结果的主要价值不是数值增益，而是把 原先依赖采样的无界二参数问题封闭为有限、精确、可复核的全域证书。
en: Relative to the fixed rational weight in R0.51, the additional relative radius is only about \(6.732\times10^{-12}\). The main value is not the numerical gain, but the conversion of a formerly sampling-dependent unbounded two-parameter problem into a finite, exact, auditable full-domain certificate.

zh: 相对 R0.52 的完整单仿射全局上界，固定重启半径的严格增益 超过 \(9.2209\) ppm，根盒下端的严格增益超过 \(10.7949\) ppm。 因而乘积仿射族不会必然退化到单仿射边界。
en: Relative to the complete R0.52 single-affine global upper bound, the strict gain of the fixed restart radius exceeds \(9.2209\) ppm and the strict gain of the root-box lower endpoint exceeds \(10.7949\) ppm. Thus the product-affine family need not degenerate to the single-affine boundary.

zh: 相对 R0.52 完整单仿射上界，乘积族的总增益严格位于 10.7949 与 11.8345 ppm 之间；即使完整优化，超过 R0.53 见证的剩余因子也小于 \(1.0000010395514554756\)。 这低于预设 \(10^{-4}\) 继续门槛约两个数量级，因此我停止 继续增加荷权多项式次数。
en: Relative to the R0.52 upper bound for the complete single-affine family, the total gain of the product family lies strictly between 10.7949 and 11.8345 ppm; even after complete optimization, the remaining factor beyond the R0.53 witness is below \(1.0000010395514554756\). This is about two orders of magnitude below the predeclared \(10^{-4}\) continuation threshold, so I stop increasing the polynomial degree of the charge weight.

zh: 相干频率包与固定输出障碍
en: Coherent frequency packet and fixed-output obstruction

zh: 相关二块加权列、五扇区全阶定理与 0.376 重启
en: Correlated two-block weighted columns, the five-sector all-order theorem, and the restart at 0.376

zh: 相互作用核公式、对称性清单、最坏三波族、候选不等式反例库。
en: Interaction kernel formula, symmetry list, worst triad family, candidate inequality counterexamples library.

zh: 相邻 \(r=0.371\) 的大荷界仍为 \(0.9714014422<1\)， 但继承的有限荷 \(s=-1\) 界为 \(1.0008564924>1\)。 负向控制由此把下一处可处理瓶颈定位到固定荷列，而不是无穷大荷扇区。
en: At the adjacent radius \(r=0.371\), the large-charge bound remains \(0.9714014422<1\), but the inherited finite-charge \(s=-1\) bound is \(1.0008564924>1\). The negative control therefore locates the next tractable bottleneck in a fixed-charge column rather than in the infinite large-charge sector.

zh: 相邻 \(r=0.376933\) 的同一真实列为 \(1.0000026584572409359>1\)，而大荷与伸缩仍通过。 这证明当前诱导二块加权 \(\ell^1\) 充分判据确实失败，但不证明 奇性、解析延拓失败或其他范数失败。
en: At the adjacent \(r=0.376933\), the same exact column is \(1.0000026584572409359>1\), while the large-charge and stretch gates still pass. This proves that the current induced two-block weighted \(\ell^1\) sufficient criterion truly fails, but it does not prove a singularity, failure of analytic continuation, or failure of other norms.

zh: 相邻 \(r=0.377\) 的继承大正荷共同斜率界为 \(1.0030411177>1\)，而多项式正则伸缩仍为 \(0.9916535448<1\)。下一瓶颈因此是大正荷扇区的现有充分界， 不是 \(s=-1\) 通道。
en: At the adjacent radius \(r=0.377\), the inherited common-slope large-positive-charge bound is \(1.0030411177>1\), while the polynomial regular stretch remains \(0.9916535448<1\). The next bottleneck is therefore the current sufficient bound for the large-positive-charge sector, not the \(s=-1\) channel.

zh: 相同仿射位移上的符号路径先合并，再对缺陷取绝对值。 零六次 jet 的余项尺度精确降为 \(65536/16^7=1/4096\)。 十种时间次序的七阶偏导在五单形上逐项积分，完整原始上界 为 \(5.1612521669\times10^{-5}\)，证书采用更宽的 \(6\times10^{-5}\) 保护值。
en: Signed paths with the same affine shift are combined before absolute values are applied to the defect. The remainder scale of a zero sixth-order jet drops exactly to \(65536/16^7=1/4096\). Seventh derivatives for all ten time orderings are integrated term by term over the five-simplex; the complete raw upper bound is \(5.1612521669\times10^{-5}\), and the certificate uses the wider guarded value \(6\times10^{-5}\).

zh: 写出 Fourier 系数方程 \[ \partial_t\widehat u(k)+\nu|k|^2\widehat u(k) =-i\!\!\sum_{p+q=k}\!(q\cdot\widehat u(p))\,\mathbb P_k\widehat u(q), \] 并核对实值、无散与三波能量交换对称性。
en: Write the Fourier coefficient equation \[ \partial_t\widehat u(k)+\nu|k|^2\widehat u(k) =-i\!\!\sum_{p+q=k}\!(q\cdot\widehat u(p))\,\mathbb P_k\widehat u(q), \] and check real-valued, divergence-free, and three-wave energy exchange symmetries.

zh: 新的全阶主动尾界为 \(0.9988814424<1\)，完整球映射与 Lipschitz 门严格闭合； 正则伸缩界为 \(0.7676483832<1\)，所以主动场、伸缩场和正则场 \(U,V\) 在共同半径 \(r_*=33/100\) 上获得认证。 相邻 \(0.331\) 的改进主动尾界仍为 \(1.0038955266>1\)。
en: The new all-order active-tail bound is \(0.9988814424<1\), and the full ball-mapping and Lipschitz gates close strictly. The regular-dilation bound is \(0.7676483832<1\), so the active field, dilation field, and regular fields \(U,V\) are certified at the common radius \(r_*=33/100\). The improved active-tail bound at the neighboring point \(0.331\) remains \(1.0038955266>1\).

zh: 新旧双圆盘不嵌套：\(Z\) 半径增加，\(W\) 半径减少。 但固定荷变量 \(R=Z^2W\) 的认证圆盘半径满足 \(\rho_R=r^3\)，相对 R0.48 的保守增益因子大于 \(1.0459367903514846826\)。这是一项约化 Banach 空间几何结论， 不是完整三维 PDE 的解析半径结论。
en: The old and new bidisks are not nested: the \(Z\) radius increases while the \(W\) radius decreases. But the certified disk radius of the fixed-charge variable \(R=Z^2W\) satisfies \(\rho_R=r^3\), giving a conservative gain factor greater than \(1.0459367903514846826\) relative to R0.48. This is a geometric statement about the reduced Banach space, not the analytic radius of the full three-dimensional PDE.

zh: 新增的 3,584 个完整目标扫描延伸到 \(L=1,M=2048\)。合并后， 有限证书覆盖 4,042 个不同三元组和 27,082,065,198 条有序路径， 整体观测最大值仍约为 \(0.0013286563\)，没有显示平方根增长。
en: The 3,584 new complete-target scans extend through \(L=1,M=2048\). Combined with earlier data, the certificate covers 4,042 distinct triples and 27,082,065,198 ordered paths; the overall maximum remains about \(0.0013286563\), with no square-root growth visible.

zh: 需要分开看的几件事
en: Several things that need to be considered separately

zh: 选取临界范数不趋零、并通过 \((w\cdot\nabla)U_r\) 非平凡耦合的三维 Fourier 边带；先求线性化非正规传播子的尺度律，再判断增长是否触及缩放临界延拓判据。
en: Choose a three-dimensional Fourier sideband whose critical norm does not vanish and that couples nontrivially through \((w\cdot\nabla)U_r\); first derive the scaling law of the linearized non-normal propagator, then determine whether its growth reaches a scale-critical continuation criterion.

zh: 压力非局部
en: Nonlocal pressure

zh: 压力与局部预算
en: Pressure and local budgets

zh: 严格计算同位移符号聚合后的零八次 jet 缺陷、主根预解式和全局九阶热导数界，决定数值负信号能否升级为严格定理。
en: Rigorously compute the degree-zero-to-eight jet defect after same-shift signed aggregation, the dominant-root resolvent, and a global ninth-derivative bound for the heat kernel, to determine whether the numerical negative signal can be upgraded to a theorem.

zh: 严格结论
en: Strict conclusion

zh: 严格局部极小只属于所选四个实极化图坐标与振幅比组成的五变量第五阶模型； 其他正参数根、边界族、复相位、Taylor 余项和 PDE 动力学仍未关闭。
en: Strict local minimizers only belong to the five-variable fifth-order model selected from four real polarization graph coordinates and amplitude ratios; other positive parameters, boundary families, complex phases, Taylor remainders, and PDE dynamics are still not closed.

zh: 沿 R0.60 的唯一剪切 Picard 链，我把四次目标相对二次目标的系数写成 \[ \frac{A^4\widehat G_4(0,m,t_H)}{A^2\widehat G_2(0,m,t_H)} =-\frac{\varepsilon^2}{L^2}R_{L,M,m}, \qquad R_{L,M,m}=\frac{L^2m^2}{H^3}\frac{S_{4,m}}{S_{2,m}}. \] 其中 \(S_{4,m}\) 是全部两正一负载频路径的有序和；重复热率由合流差商严格处理。
en: Along the unique shear Picard chain from R0.60, I write the quartic target coefficient relative to the quadratic target as \[ \frac{A^4\widehat G_4(0,m,t_H)}{A^2\widehat G_2(0,m,t_H)} =-\frac{\varepsilon^2}{L^2}R_{L,M,m}, \qquad R_{L,M,m}=\frac{L^2m^2}{H^3}\frac{S_{4,m}}{S_{2,m}}. \] Here \(S_{4,m}\) is the ordered sum over every carrier path with two positive and one negative sign; repeated heat rates are handled exactly by confluent divided differences.

zh: 沿滤波速度轨道取真实应变源 \(\Sigma=S(U)(X(t),t)\)，并令 \(q=\Sigma:B\)。完整联合账本保留应变自作用、解析涡量、偏差压力 Hessian、黏性、次网格 Hessian 与协方差余项。局部二次组合已经双符号；更一般地，对任意 \(C^1\) 瞬时局部标量 \(\Phi(\Sigma,B)\)，外部压力包产生 \[ \dot\Phi\big|_H=-D_\Sigma\Phi:H^\circ. \] 在声明的缓冲与滤波条件下，若导数对所有光滑初值具有统一单边符号，就必须有 \(D_\Sigma\Phi=0\)。
en: Along the filtered-velocity trajectory, take the actual strain source \(\Sigma=S(U)(X(t),t)\) and set \(q=\Sigma:B\). The complete joint ledger retains strain self-interaction, resolved vorticity, the deviatoric pressure Hessian, viscosity, the subgrid Hessian, and covariance residuals. The local quadratic combination already has both signs. More generally, for any \(C^1\) instantaneous local scalar \(\Phi(\Sigma,B)\), the exterior pressure packet contributes \[ \dot\Phi\big|_H=-D_\Sigma\Phi:H^\circ. \] Under the stated buffer and filtering conditions, a uniform one-sided derivative sign for all smooth initial data forces \(D_\Sigma\Phi=0\).

en: An exact 24-velocity-mode Fourier witness gives the weighted pressure pairing \(-676/40425\) and the weighted Betchov pairing \(228/2695\), while both unweighted values are exactly zero. All six localized terms scale as \(\lambda^3\); all 14 formal checks passed.

en: a parsing 2D3C candidate significantly reduces normal leakage and extends finite-dimensional critical growth.

zh: 一个精确同号电荷模式族满足输入与输出解析半径完全可加； 有序相互作用除以 \(N^2\) 趋于 \(27/2\)，对称二次相互作用趋于 \(27\)。 同一族上的无量纲热率只趋于 \(1/12,1/12,1/3\)，不能支付 \(N^2\) 损失。
en: a precise same-sign charge mode family satisfies input and output analytic radii fully additive; ordered interactions divided by \(N^2\) tend to \(27/2\), symmetric quadratic interactions tend to \(27\). The dimensionless heat rate on the same family only tends to \(1/12,1/12,1/3\) and cannot pay for \(N^2\) loss.

zh: 一个零有符号积分、零余项的非交换应变回路具有双曲有序指数；拉回协方差保持不变，物理协方差却接近秩一。仿射不变 SPD 度量虽能去掉条件数，却要求 \(Q\succ0\)；精确无外力周期剪切流已经产生真实秩一协方差，使单尺度逆协方差路线失效。
en: A noncommutative strain loop with zero signed integral and zero residual has a hyperbolic ordered exponential; the pulled-back covariance remains fixed while the physical covariance approaches rank one. Although an affine-invariant SPD metric removes the condition number, it requires \(Q\succ0\); an exact unforced periodic shear flow already produces a genuine rank-one covariance, invalidating the single-scale inverse-covariance route.

zh: 一个四叶临界包达到 \(N^3\) 配对阈值，并把第一代输出集中到跨壳目标；中心映射的一维极化像同时给出新的迭代障碍。
en: a four-leaf critical packet reaches \(N^3\) pairing threshold, focusing first-generation output onto trans-shell targets; the one-dimensional polarization of the central mapping simultaneously provides a new iterative obstruction.

zh: 一个张量 Rudin--Shapiro 高频壳可以同时维持 \(M\) 个相干低频输出。完整第一 Picard 项在热 Besov 与周期 \(BMO^{-1}\) 中继续达到临界饱和；输出多重性和各向同性平方函数不会自动恢复壳衰减。
en: One tensor Rudin--Shapiro high shell can simultaneously sustain \(M\) coherent low-frequency outputs. The complete first Picard term remains critically saturated in heat Besov and periodic \(BMO^{-1}\); output multiplicity and isotropic square functions do not automatically restore shell decay.

en: Partition the candidate endpoint into time shells at the packet heat-time ratio \(\beta=256\). If the R0.69D stability gate keeps failing, the only consequence is \[ \limsup_{j\to\infty}V_j\sqrt{h_j} \ge\frac{0.0261263630\ldots}{C_S}. \] Standard \(L^\infty\) local continuation already gives a positive lower bound on every sufficiently late shell. This is therefore not a new Leray-Serrin condition.

zh: 翼门系数 \(h_n=\sqrt3\,4^n/\sqrt{2\cdot16^n+1}\) 与跨壳门系数 \(g_n\) 都趋于 \(\sqrt{3/2}\)， 所以中心接力没有壳层退化。 但是生成模态的反向作用会离开原来的一维极化线；显式线外缺陷趋于 \(3/(2\sqrt2)\)，约为前向门的 \(86.6\%\)。
en: wing gate coefficient \(h_n=\sqrt3\,4^n/\sqrt{2\cdot16^n+1}\) with cross-shell gate coefficients \(g_n\) tend to \(\sqrt{3/2}\), therefore the central relay does not exhibit shell degeneration. However, the reverse action of generated modes tends to leave the original one-dimensional polarized line; explicit line exterior defects tend to \(3/(2\sqrt2)\), approximately the forward door's \(86.6\%\).

Therefore, \(A_L\le2K^{L-1}/L^3\) and \(\|U_L\|_1,\|V_L\|_1\le K^{L-1}/L^3\). The fields \(a,U,V\) are absolutely analytic on the polydisc of radius \(1/96\); on the polydisc of radius \(1/192\), \(U/Z\) and \(V/W\) remain within \(1/8\) of 1, so the logarithms, \(\phi\), and the exponential factorization are analytic.

Thus \(H_2=8\) and \(H_L\le27/4\) for every \(L\ge3\). After checking \(A_2=3\) directly, the new constant \(K=81/4\) closes the induction and gives \(A_L\le2K^{L-1}/L^3\) together with \(\|U_L\|_1,\|V_L\|_1\le K^{L-1}/L^3\).

zh: 因此固定输出块、Fourier \(\mathcal X^{-1}\) 与临界 \(\dot H^{1/2}\) 的归一化双线性比值分别为 \(\Theta(L^{-2})\)、\(\Theta(L^{-1})\)、\(\Theta(L^{-3})\)。 时间积分确实提供了高频增益。
en: Therefore, the normalized bilinear ratios for the fixed output block, Fourier \(\mathcal X^{-1}\), and critical \(\dot H^{1/2}\) are \(\Theta(L^{-2})\), \(\Theta(L^{-1})\), and \(\Theta(L^{-3})\), respectively. Time integration really does provide a high-frequency gain.

zh: 因而 \(g_N\) 精确地与壳比无关；若 \(\varepsilon\le\rho<1\)，则 \(g_T\le(1+\rho)/2<1\)。整数族 \(p_N=(N,N,0)\)、\(q_N=(-N-1,-N,0)\)、\(k=(-1,0,0)\) 证明分离极限 \(1/2\) 尖锐。另一方面，R0.55 的饱和族仍满足 \(g_N=1\)，而且在交换对称化后不消失。
en: Thus \(g_N\) is exactly independent of the shell ratio; if \(\varepsilon\le\rho<1\), then \(g_T\le(1+\rho)/2<1\). The integer family \(p_N=(N,N,0)\), \(q_N=(-N-1,-N,0)\), \(k=(-1,0,0)\) proves that the separation limit \(1/2\) is sharp. On the other hand, the saturation family of R0.55 still satisfies \(g_N=1\) and does not vanish after exchange symmetrization.

zh: 因而任意复催化振幅的全局极小值精确等于 \(45.73934896472748\ldots\)，等号恰在等幅同相轨道达到。 随后把四个实输入极化的切向导数直接传播到完整第五阶树，得到单位角梯度 \((-35.3079,35.3079,-27.3318,27.3318)\)。固定 R0.11 极化不是该比值的驻点。
en: therefore the global minimum of any complex catalytic amplitude is precisely equal to \(45.73934896472748\ldots\), with equality holding exactly when the amplitudes are in phase and identical. subsequently the tangential derivatives of the four real input polarizations are directly propagated to the complete fifth-order tree, yielding a unit angular gradient \((-35.3079,35.3079,-27.3318,27.3318)\). fixing R0.11 polarization is not an extremum for this ratio.

zh: 因而整个 \([0.376932,0.376933]\) 上，诱导范数都等于同一个 活跃真实列：根下小于一，根处等于一，根上大于一。这是当前 二块加权 \(\ell^1\) 范数的局部锐阈值，不是 PDE 奇性或正则性定理。
en: Therefore, throughout \([0.376932,0.376933]\), the induced norm equals the same true active column: it is below one beneath the root, equal to one at the root, and above one above the root. This is a local sharp threshold for the current two-block weighted \(\ell^1\) norm, not a PDE singularity or regularity theorem.

en: therefore optimizing only two groups of asymmetric angles would lead to a loss of a strictly decreasing direction. i then took rational parameters \(m=28/155\), \(n=7/25\), and \(x=5377/5000\) for the precise comparison of 332 aggregated frequencies, obtaining an external/target ratio \(18.035985268234917\ldots\), with a target energy proportion of \(5.2532085201\ldots\%\).

zh: 用 MPFR 定向舍入封闭十阶三角矩提升、热系数和缺陷预解式；只有最终区间完全离开零，才升级为严格热符号定理。
en: Use MPFR directed rounding to enclose the degree-ten triangular moment lift, heat coefficients, and defect resolvent; upgrade to a rigorous heat-sign theorem only if the final interval stays entirely away from zero.

zh: 用外向舍入区间严格封闭 \(\mathcal A_0(a)/a\) 的三个系数与 \(\mathcal A_{-2}(0)\)，认证负判别式并处理端点；证书必须覆盖真实光滑卷积截断，而不只是其浮点求积近似。
en: Use outward-rounded intervals to enclose rigorously the three coefficients of \(\mathcal A_0(a)/a\) and the endpoint value \(\mathcal A_{-2}(0)\), certify the negative discriminant, and handle the endpoint. The certificate must cover the actual smooth convolution cutoff, not merely its floating-point quadrature approximation.

zh: 优化 \(\tau,\lambda\) 与时间片分区，把 \(\mathfrak M_v(T_r)\gtrsim\rho^{-r/2}\) 转换成逼近候选奇性端点时某个明确、尺度一致的参考量发散下界；若只重述经典 Leray 或 Serrin 条件，则记录后停止该分支。
en: Optimize \(\tau,\lambda\) and the time partition to convert \(\mathfrak M_v(T_r)\gtrsim\rho^{-r/2}\) into a divergence lower bound for an explicit, scale-consistent reference quantity as a candidate singular endpoint is approached. If this only restates a classical Leray or Serrin condition, record that outcome and stop the branch.

zh: 由此得到一个一般 \(N\ge2\) 的条件不等式：只要两个归一化尖锐坐标都是 \(O(N^{-1})\)，真实生成增益就一致有界。 160 位与 224 位 MPFR 递推进一步计算到 \(N=5\)；四个点的 \(N|\sigma|\) 都低于 \(0.214\)，生成增益都低于 \(0.422\)。
en: This gives a conditional inequality for every \(N\ge2\): if both normalized sharp coordinates are \(O(N^{-1})\), the generated gain is uniformly bounded. The 160-bit and 224-bit MPFR recurrences extend the calculation to \(N=5\); at all four points, \(N|\sigma|\) is below \(0.214\), and the generated gain is below \(0.422\).

zh: 有限 Fourier 场与集中序列都是运动学测试，不是 Navier–Stokes 奇解。本节关闭的是协方差功的纯投影符号律和现有能量方法的直接 \(L_t^2\) 路线；它没有否定新的动力学、残差、BMO 或 Carleson 补偿，也没有解决千禧年问题。
en: The finite Fourier fields and the concentration sequence are kinematic tests, not singular Navier–Stokes solutions. This section closes the pure-projector sign law for covariance work and the direct \(L_t^2\) route through the current energy method; it does not rule out new dynamical, residual, BMO, or Carleson compensation, nor does it solve the Millennium Prize Problem.

en: After the finite cascade route stalled, I turned to an analytic reduction and developed an infinite-charge majorant, short continuation, and weight optimization.

zh: 有限一次矩谱小于 \(26\)，其余质量谱小于 \(300\)，主根 \(402.425429345624<\mu<402.4254293456256\)。故 \[ 26<256<300<\mu, \] 且 \((\mu-\mathcal P)^{-1}\) 在零仿射余项空间上严格存在。 七层直接五多项式卷积逐状态验证了质量和全部四个一次矩。
en: The finite first-moment spectrum is below \(26\), the remaining mass spectrum is below \(300\), and the dominant root satisfies \(402.425429345624<\mu<402.4254293456256\). Hence \[ 26<256<300<\mu, \] and \((\mu-\mathcal P)^{-1}\) exists rigorously on the zero-affine remainder space. Seven-level direct five-polynomial convolution verifies the mass and all four first moments state by state.

zh: 有序临界核精确分解为法向与面内两个 Leray 输出通道。面内通道在分离壳中有严格间隙和尖锐的二分之一极限；法向通道与壳比无关，在正角向平均和对称化后仍保留常数一障碍。
en: The ordered critical kernel decomposes exactly into two Leray output channels: normal and in-plane. The in-plane channel has a strict gap and a sharp one-half limit on separated shells; the normal channel is independent of the shell ratio and retains the constant-one obstruction after positive angular averaging and symmetrization.

zh: 原计划的 62 维低阶逆在认证尾空间上等同于恒等映射，因此不改善缺陷算子。 这项严格负审计终止了该预条件架构。附近半径 \(19/160\) 的同一充分界为 \(1.0007181>1\)，只标记当前方法边界，不是奇点证据。
en: The proposed 62-dimensional low-order inverse acts as the identity on the certified tail space and therefore does not improve the defect operator. This rigorous negative audit ends that preconditioning architecture. The same sufficient bound at the nearby radius \(19/160\) is \(1.0007181>1\); it marks only the current method boundary and is not evidence of a singularity.

zh: 允许在全空间 \(\mathbb R^3\) 或周期空间 \(\mathbb T^3=\mathbb R^3/\mathbb Z^3\) 上作答。正面答案需要证明： 对任意满足规定衰减或周期条件的光滑无散初值，存在全局光滑解。负面答案则需要按正式问题允许的条件构造有限时破裂。
en: Answers are permitted on either full space \(\mathbb R^3\) or periodic space \(\mathbb T^3=\mathbb R^3/\mathbb Z^3\). Positive answers require proof: for any smooth divergence-free initial data satisfying specified decay or periodic conditions, there exists a global smooth solution. Negative answers must construct finite-time blow-up under the conditions allowed by the formal problem.

zh: 在 \(\mathbb R^3\) 上，方程具有缩放
en: on \(\mathbb R^3\) the equation has scaling

zh: 在 \(\mathbb T^3\) 上，对任意光滑、周期、无散且平均为零的初值 \(u_0\)，证明无外力方程存在唯一全局光滑解。 周期情形避免了无穷远衰减的附加技术问题，也天然适合 Fourier 分析；它本身就是完整的千禧年问题选项，而非弱化版。
en: on \(\mathbb T^3\) for any smooth periodic divergence-free and mean-zero initial data \(u_0\) prove that the force-free equation exists with a unique global smooth solution. The periodic case avoids additional technical issues at infinity, also naturally fits Fourier analysis; it is itself a complete millennium problem option rather than a weakened version.

zh: 在 \(\mathbb T^3\) 上设 \(P_j\) 为 Littlewood–Paley 频率投影，并定义临界频率包络
en: on \(\mathbb T^3\) let \(P_j\) be the Littlewood–Paley frequency projection and define the critical frequency envelope

zh: 在 \(M=16,\ q=2,\ T=\log2/2\) 上，五载频约束留下 34,690 个有效元组。包含全部十种 \((3,2)\)-shuffle 后， 共得到 346,900 条有序带符号路径；每条路径都直接验证 终点频率 \(k_5=0\)。
en: At \(M=16,\ q=2,\ T=\log2/2\), the five-carrier constraint leaves 34,690 valid tuples. Including all ten \((3,2)\)-shuffles gives 346,900 signed ordered paths, and every path directly verifies the terminal frequency \(k_5=0\).

zh: 在 \(M=16\) 的第一周期，7,823,536 个有效载频组与 35 种时间次序产生 273,823,760 条有序路径。精确后缀 动态规划把它们压缩为最多 105,499 个状态，并在 44 次 有理 Taylor 审计中得到 \[ 0.0074150893675487776 <S_{8,q}^{(M=16)} <0.0074150893936092571. \] 绝对尾小于 \(1.304\times10^{-11}\)，所以这个有限热块严格为正。
en: In the first cycle at \(M=16\), 7,823,536 valid carrier tuples and 35 time orderings produce 273,823,760 ordered paths. Exact suffix dynamic programming compresses them to at most 105,499 states, and an order-44 rational Taylor audit gives \[ 0.0074150893675487776 <S_{8,q}^{(M=16)} <0.0074150893936092571. \] The absolute tail is below \(1.304\times10^{-11}\), so this finite heat block is rigorously positive.

At \(N=80\) and \(r_*=59/500\), the new tail bound is \(0.99249599847994349<1\), while the old full-space bound is \(1.95368290392552397>1\). The complete exact residual is about \(7.4633\times10^{-70}\), only about \(2.12\times10^{-64}\) of the contraction allowance; the ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and transport bounds are all strictly below one.

zh: 在 \(N=80\)、\(r_*=9/32\) 上，全阶主动尾界为 \(0.7785423316<1\)，完整两端点输运界为 \(0.9962112032<1\)，6345 项完整残差与无穷尾球均由精确有理数闭合。 相邻探针 \(141/500=0.282\) 的主动固定点仍通过，但输运界为 \(1.0003750452>1\)，所以下一瓶颈已经明确落在 \(x=2\) 输运端点。
en: At \(N=80\) and \(r_*=9/32\), the all-order active-tail bound is \(0.7785423316<1\), the complete two-endpoint transport bound is \(0.9962112032<1\), and the 6,345-term complete residual and infinite tail ball close in exact rational arithmetic. At the adjacent probe \(141/500=0.282\), the active fixed point still passes but transport is \(1.0003750452>1\), so the next bottleneck is now precisely the \(x=2\) transport endpoint.

At \(r=0.370\), the two endpoints are \(0.5602559667\) and \(0.9662130058\), and the complete active-tail bound is \(0.9970118412<1\). The ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and regular-stretch gates all close strictly, so the common radius reaches \(37/100\).

At \(r=0.371\), the negative derivative of all 27 \(q=1\) terms is at most \(0.1686475501\), while the seed lower bound is \(1.113\), leaving the complete derivative margin \(0.9443524499>0\). Thus every admissible \(j>80\) is covered, and the exact maximum is attained at \(j=82\).

At \(r=0.376932\), the large-charge bound falls to \(0.9971370846<1\), and the true bottleneck becomes \(s=162,j=81\): \[ 0.9999973490826196656<1. \] The ball-mapping, Lipschitz, and regular-stretch gates all pass, so the common radius reaches \(94233/250000\).

zh: 在变量 \(r=z^2w,\xi=z^{-1}\) 下，漂移端点变成固定 Laurent 电荷：\(b_N=[r^N\xi^1](A,S)\)。 160 位与 224 位 MPFR 计算扩展到 \(N=75\)，两套结果的最大相对差为 \(3.21\times10^{-43}\)。
en: In the variables \(r=z^2w,\xi=z^{-1}\), the drifting endpoint becomes a fixed Laurent charge: \(b_N=[r^N\xi^1](A,S)\). The 160-bit and 224-bit MPFR calculations extend through \(N=75\), with a maximum relative discrepancy of \(3.21\times10^{-43}\).

zh: 在电荷坐标中，负电荷叶 \(a_{0,-1}=1\) 使 \(q\) 扇区的方程必含 \(k f_{k,q+1}\)。 因而任何固定上界的有限电荷带都不能闭合；R0.28 提出的有限扇区锥路线被严格排除，下一步必须使用带权无限阶梯或指数奇点分析。
en: In charge coordinates, the negative-charge leaf \(a_{0,-1}=1\) forces the equation in sector \(q\) to contain \(k f_{k,q+1}\). Thus no finite charge band with a fixed upper bound can close; the finite-sector cone proposed in R0.28 is rigorously ruled out, and the next step must use a weighted infinite ladder or exponential-singularity analysis.

zh: 在根盒上端半径消去 \(\alpha\) 后，可行性要求单变量函数 \(E(r_U,c)\ge0\)。其对数导数多项式只有三次 Descartes 变号， 三个严格变号根盒恰好穷尽全部正根；在唯一内部极值盒上， \(c^2E\) 的 317 个 Bernstein 系数全部为负。结合两端解析排除， 得到 \[ \begin{aligned} 0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330925 &<R_{\mathrm{aff}},\\ R_{\mathrm{aff}} &<0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330926. \end{aligned} \]
en: After eliminating \(\alpha\) at the upper root-box radius, feasibility requires the one-variable function \(E(r_U,c)\ge0\). Its logarithmic-derivative polynomial has only three Descartes sign variations, and three strict sign-changing root boxes exhaust all positive roots. In the unique interior extremum box, all 317 Bernstein coefficients of \(c^2E\) are negative. Combined with analytic exclusion at both ends, this gives \[ \begin{aligned} 0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330925 &<R_{\mathrm{aff}},\\ R_{\mathrm{aff}} &<0.3826244718485988314760952288871012330926. \end{aligned} \]

zh: 在旧半径 \(4/81\) 上，R0.31 主控直接给出 \(\|D\Phi(a)\|<80/81\)，所以 Jacobian 具有真正的无穷维 Neumann 逆。 把前 40 层精确系数与其后的解析尾界结合，边界上的逆范数上界进一步改善为约 \(3.306365\)。
en: At the old radius \(4/81\), the R0.31 majorant directly gives \(\|D\Phi(a)\|<80/81\), so the Jacobian has a genuine infinite-dimensional Neumann inverse. Combining the first 40 exact layers with the analytic tail bound improves the boundary inverse-norm upper bound to about \(3.306365\).

zh: 在邻近整洁点 \(m=6/35\)、\(n=3/7\)、\(x=37/14\)， 15 组二阶 Laurent 负幂全部抵消。 成对交换对称把五维 Hessian 分成 \(2+3\) 两块； 五个 Sylvester 顺序主子式都由有理运算证明严格为正。
en: At the neighboring clean point \(m=6/35\), \(n=3/7\), and \(x=37/14\), 15 pairs of second-order Laurent negative powers are completely cancelled. The paired commutation splits the five-dimensional Hessian into two parts: \(2+3\); all five Sylvester leading principal minors are proved to be strictly positive by rational operations.

zh: 在球上分离压力的近场 Newton 部分与调和远场部分，逐阶减去远场多极矩，检验领先四极项是否仍保持临界大小。
en: Separate pressure on a ball into its near-field Newtonian and harmonic far-field parts, subtract far-field multipoles order by order, and test whether the leading quadrupole remains at critical size.

zh: 在取绝对值以前按环带保留有符号几何核，研究相邻尺度部分和是否产生可求和的临界通量亏损。
en: Retain the signed geometric kernel by annuli before taking absolute values, and test whether partial sums over neighboring scales produce a summable critical flux deficit.

zh: 在实边界 \(h=0\) 上，子结式消元与 Sturm 根隔离覆盖了全部边界和内部驻点： 等幅同相点是全局最优，外部/目标比为 \(45.73934896472748\ldots\)。 对一般复振幅，94 个精确 Bernstein 叶盒证明全局下界 \(45.739348\)，与该实可行点只差不到 \(10^{-6}\)。
en: On the real boundary \(h=0\), the subdeterminant elimination and Sturm root isolation cover all boundaries and internal stationary points: equal amplitude in-phase points are globally optimal; the external/target ratio is \(45.73934896472748\ldots\). For general complex amplitudes, 94 exact Bernstein box estimates prove a global lower bound \(45.739348\), differing from this real feasible point by less than \(10^{-6}\).

zh: 在四阶临界振幅上，零时间八阶形式比率的块速率严格小于 \(256/625<41/100\)。
en: At quartic-critical amplitude, the block rate of the formal zero-time eighth-order ratio is strictly less than \(256/625<41/100\).

zh: 在四维载频立方体中心保留全部六次中心矩。每态共有 \({10\choose4}=210\) 个通道，320 态系统因此提升为 67,200 维三角 jet。质量主向量由精确 Chinese-remainder 投影隔离，六阶有限主项落在 \[ -9.70\times10^{-7} <B_6 <-9.48\times10^{-7}. \]
en: Retain all centred moments through degree six at the centre of the four-dimensional carrier-frequency cube. Each state has \({10\choose4}=210\) channels, so the 320-state system lifts to a 67,200-dimensional triangular jet. An exact Chinese-remainder projection isolates the dominant mass eigenvector, and the finite sixth-order dominant term lies in \[ -9.70\times10^{-7} <B_6 <-9.48\times10^{-7}. \]

zh: 在同一滤波与截断体系中让真实低频应变源开始演化，并显式保留偏差压力 Hessian、黏性和次网格项。
en: Within the same filtering and cutoff framework, let the actual low-frequency strain source begin to evolve, explicitly retaining the deviatoric pressure Hessian, viscosity, and subgrid terms.

zh: 在新半径 \[r_*=\frac{16}{243}=\frac43\frac4{81}\] 上，四十阶中心多项式的完整精确残差为 \(2.999049187948959763\times10^{-46}\)，线性化上界为 \(0.95194169562439524\)。 显式尾球的映射上界为 \(0.00386050865925092\)，Lipschitz 常数为 \(0.97597084781219762<1\)。 因而 Banach 定理构造出同一典范形式解，固定荷解析下界同步提高 \(64/27\) 倍。
en: At the new radius \[r_*=\frac{16}{243}=\frac43\frac4{81}\], the complete exact residual of the degree-40 center polynomial is \(2.999049187948959763\times10^{-46}\), and the linearization upper bound is \(0.95194169562439524\). The explicit tail ball has mapping upper bound \(0.00386050865925092\) and Lipschitz constant \(0.97597084781219762<1\). Banach's theorem therefore constructs the same canonical formal solution, while the fixed-charge analytic lower bound increases by a factor of \(64/27\).

zh: 在有符号 Biot–Savart 核中保留 \(\omega(x)\times(\omega(x+z)-\omega(x))\) 的非局部差分，精确优化近场/远场分裂，检验是否出现真正的尺度增益。
en: Retain the nonlocal difference \(\omega(x)\times(\omega(x+z)-\omega(x))\) inside the signed Biot–Savart kernel, optimize the near/far-field split exactly, and test for a genuine scale gain.

zh: 在有限分离 \(\varepsilon=1/4\) 上，按解析总量作分子的 P18 扫描以 167,772,160 个点对得到最佳 \(a=0.1595\)、探索性比值 \(0.9635537\)。 独立 P19 区对估计随后确认 \(\mathcal A_0=-6.2919\times10^{-4}\pm1.0343\times10^{-5}\)， 负号约离零 61 个报告标准误。第三套共同样本三次审计显示：4001 点网格上每个振幅至少有 \(j=-2,0\) 之一为负，最佳最小值仍为 \(-2.95\times10^{-4}\)。
en: At finite separation \(\varepsilon=1/4\), the P18 screen used the analytic total as numerator and 167,772,160 point pairs to obtain the best \(a=0.1595\) and an exploratory ratio of \(0.9635537\). An independent P19 zone-pair estimate then confirmed \(\mathcal A_0=-6.2919\times10^{-4}\pm1.0343\times10^{-5}\), with the negative sign about 61 reported standard errors from zero. A third common-sample cubic audit showed that at every amplitude on a 4001-point grid at least one of \(j=-2,0\) is negative, and the best minimum remains \(-2.95\times10^{-4}\).

zh: 在与 R0.5 相同的 Galerkin 设置中，候选到 \(\tau=0.05\) 的临界能量平方增加约 14.1%， 但到 \(\tau=0.1\) 前后仍然换号并转为衰减。
en: In the same Galerkin setting as R0.5, the critical energy square increases by about 14.1% to \(\tau=0.05\); but it changes sign and decays before reaching \(\tau=0.1\).
